translations.literal: Year 18 fourth month guihai, eleventh month renyin, year 20 eleventh month yisi through dingwei, year 22 seventh month bingwu, year 23 second month xinsi, year 24 intercalary first month wuyin, year 25 tenth month xinmao, year 26 fourth month bingshen, year 27 fourth month dingsi, eleventh month bingxu through yiwei, year 28 eleventh month yiyou through jichou, year 29 sixth month wushen and jiayin, year 30 sixth month bingzi through xinsi, year 31 first month bingxu through bingshen, year 32 second month xinwei through jiaxu, seventh month wuchen through xinwei, year 35 fifth month renwu, tenth month guimao through bingwu, year 36 twelfth month gengchen new moon, year 38 seventh month guiyou, year 39 first month gengyin through renchen—all the same.
translations.idiomatic: Jiajing 18/IV/guihai through 39/I/gengyin–renchen (the dates enumerated above): in each case likewise.

sentences.zh: 四十年三月丙子，昼见，历二十四日。

translations.literal: Year 40 third month bingzi, visible in daytime, lasting twenty-four days.
translations.idiomatic: Jiajing 40, third month, bingzi: visible by day for twenty-four days.

sentences.zh: 八月辛未，昼见。

translations.literal: Eighth month xinwei, visible in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, xinwei: visible by day.

sentences.zh: 四十一年九月乙未，四十二年四月己巳至壬申，四十三年五月甲寅，并如之。

translations.literal: Year 41 ninth month yiwei, year 42 fourth month jisi through renshen, year 43 fifth month jiayin—all the same.
translations.idiomatic: Jiajing 41/IX/yiwei, 42/IV/jisi–renshen, and 43/V/jiayin: in each case likewise.

sentences.zh: 十月戊子，昼见，历二十二日。

translations.literal: Tenth month wuzi, visible in daytime, lasting twenty-two days.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, wuzi: visible by day for twenty-two days.

sentences.zh: 四十五年正月己亥，昼见。

translations.literal: Year 45 first month jihai, visible in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: Jiajing 45, first month, jihai: visible by day.

sentences.zh: 隆庆元年七月辛酉，二年正月甲寅，并如之。

translations.literal: Longqing year 1 seventh month xinyou, year 2 first month jiayin—all the same.
translations.idiomatic: Longqing 1/VII/xinyou and 2/I/jiayin: in each case likewise.

sentences.zh: 三年三月甲子，昼见，历二十二日，四年十一月乙丑至丁卯，昼见。

translations.literal: Year 3 third month jiazi, visible in daytime, lasting twenty-two days; year 4 eleventh month yichou through dingmao, visible in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: Longqing 3/III/jiazi: visible by day for twenty-two days; Longqing 4/XI/yichou–dingmao: visible by day.

sentences.zh: 万历十一年七月辛丑，十二年七月癸巳，十六年九月丁丑，二十一年八月甲午，二十四年十月丙寅，并如之。

translations.literal: Wanli year 11 seventh month xinchou, year 12 seventh month guisi, year 16 ninth month dingchou, year 21 eighth month jiawu, year 24 tenth month bingyin—all the same.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 11/VII/xinchou, 12/VII/guisi, 16/IX/dingchou, 21/VIII/jiawu, and 24/X/bingyin: in each case likewise.

sentences.zh: 二十七年九月辛卯，经天。

translations.literal: Year 27 ninth month xinmao, transited heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 27, ninth month, xinmao: Venus transited heaven.

sentences.zh: 三十七年三月辛丑，昼见。

translations.literal: Year 37 third month xinchou, visible in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 37, third month, xinchou: visible by day.

sentences.zh: 三十八年十月辛巳，四十年五月壬寅，天启二年二月丙戌，三年三月丁巳，十二月乙丑，五年四月癸未，并如之。

translations.literal: Year 38 tenth month xinsi, year 40 fifth month renyin, Tianqi year 2 second month bingxu, year 3 third month dingsi, twelfth month yichou, year 5 fourth month guimao—all the same.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 38/X/xinsi, 40/V/renyin, Tianqi 2/II/bingxu, 3/III/dingsi, 3/XII/yichou, and 5/IV/guimao: in each case likewise.

sentences.zh: 七月癸酉，经天。

translations.literal: Seventh month guiyou, transited heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Tianqi 5, seventh month, guiyou: Venus transited heaven.

sentences.zh: 崇祯元年七月壬戌，昼见。

translations.literal: Chongzhen year 1 seventh month renxu, visible in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: Chongzhen 1, seventh month, renxu: visible by day.

sentences.zh: 三年四月己卯，十二月丙辰，并如之。

translations.literal: Year 3 fourth month jimao, twelfth month bingchen—all the same.
translations.idiomatic: Chongzhen 3/IV/jimao and 3/XII/bingchen: in each case likewise.

sentences.zh: ▲客星

translations.literal: ▲ Guest stars
translations.idiomatic: ▲ Guest Stars

sentences.zh: 《史记·天官书》有客星之名，而不详其形状。

translations.literal: The Records of the Historian, "Heavenly Offices," has the name guest star but does not detail its form.
translations.idiomatic: The Records of the Historian's "Heavenly Offices" names the guest star but does not describe its appearance.

sentences.zh: 叙国皇、昭明诸异星甚悉，而无瑞星、妖星之名。

translations.literal: It narrates Guohuang, Zhaoming, and other strange stars very fully, yet has no names for auspicious stars or baleful stars.
translations.idiomatic: It treats Guohuang, Zhaoming, and other anomalous stars at length, yet nowhere distinguishes auspicious stars from baleful ones.

sentences.zh: 然则客星者，言其非常有之星，殆诸异星之总名，而非有专属也。

translations.literal: Guest star, then, means a star appearing out of the ordinary—probably a general name for strange stars, not a category with fixed membership.
translations.idiomatic: The term guest star thus denotes an extraordinary apparition—likely a blanket label for anomalous stars rather than a fixed taxon.

sentences.zh: 李淳风志晋、隋天文，始分景星、含誉之属为瑞星，彗、孛、国皇之类为妖星，又以周伯老子等为客星，自谓本之汉末刘睿《荆州占》。

translations.literal: Li Chunfeng, recording Jin and Sui astronomy, first divided Jing Star, Hanyu, and the like as auspicious stars, and comets, broom-stars, Guohuang, and the like as baleful stars; he also placed Zhou Bo, Old Man, and others among guest stars, claiming this followed Liu Rui's Jingzhou Prognostications of late Han.
translations.idiomatic: Li Chunfeng's treatises on Jin and Sui astronomy first classed Jing Star, Hanyu, and their kind as auspicious stars, comets, broom-stars, Guohuang, and the like as baleful stars, and Zhou Bo, Old Man, and others as guest stars—professing to follow Liu Rui's late-Han Jingzhou Prognostications.

sentences.zh: 夫含誉，所谓瑞星也，而光芒则似彗；

translations.literal: Hanyu is called an auspicious star, yet its rays resemble a comet;
translations.idiomatic: Hanyu is styled an auspicious star, yet its radiance resembles a comet;

sentences.zh: 国皇，所谓妖星也，而形色又类南极老人。

translations.literal: Guohuang is called a baleful star, yet its form again resembles the Old Man of the Southern Pole.
translations.idiomatic: Guohuang is styled a baleful star, yet its shape recalls the Old Man of the Southern Pole.

sentences.zh: 瑞与妖果有定哉？

translations.literal: Are auspicious and baleful truly fixed?
translations.idiomatic: Can auspicious and baleful categories truly be fixed?

sentences.zh: 且周伯一星也，既属之瑞星，而云其国大昌。

translations.literal: Moreover Zhou Bo is one star, yet classed among auspicious stars it is said the state will greatly prosper.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou Bo is a single star: classed as auspicious, it foretells great prosperity for the state;

sentences.zh: 又属之客星，而云其国兵起有丧。

translations.literal: Also classed among guest stars, it is said the state will raise troops and suffer mourning.
translations.idiomatic: classed as a guest star, it foretells mobilization and mourning.

sentences.zh: 其说如此，果可为法乎？

translations.literal: When the doctrine is thus, can it serve as a rule?
translations.idiomatic: Doctrine so contradictory cannot serve as a rule.

sentences.zh: 马迁不复区别，良有以也。

translations.literal: Sima Qian did not further subdivide—and rightly so.
translations.idiomatic: That Sima Qian refused further subdivision was well judged.

sentences.zh: 今按《实录》，彗、孛变见特甚，皆别书。

translations.literal: Now examining the Veritable Records, comets and broom-stars changed and appeared with especial frequency—all are recorded separately.
translations.idiomatic: Per the Veritable Records, comets and broom-stars appeared with especial frequency; each is entered separately.

sentences.zh: 老人星则江以南常见，而燕京必无见理，故不书。

translations.literal: The Old Man star is commonly seen south of the Yangzi, yet at Yanjing there is no reason it should appear—therefore it is not recorded.
translations.idiomatic: The Old Man star is commonly seen south of the Yangzi; at Yanjing it ought not appear, and is therefore omitted.

sentences.zh: 余悉属客星而编次之。

translations.literal: All the rest are placed under guest stars and arranged in order.
translations.idiomatic: All remaining phenomena are classed as guest stars and arranged below.

sentences.zh: 洪武三年七月，太史奏文星见。

translations.literal: Hongwu year 3 seventh month, the Grand Astrologer reported the literature star appeared.
translations.idiomatic: Hongwu 3, seventh month: the Grand Astrologer reported the literature star had appeared.

sentences.zh: 九年六月戊子，有星大如弹丸，白色。

translations.literal: Year 9 sixth month wuzi, a star large as a pellet, white in color.
translations.idiomatic: Hongwu 9, sixth month, wuzi: a star as large as a pellet, white in color.

sentences.zh: 止天仓，经外屏、卷舌，入紫微垣，扫文昌，指内厨，入于张。

translations.literal: It halted at Celestial Granary, passed Outer Screen and Curled Tongue, entered the Purple Forbidden Enclosure, swept Wenchang, pointed at Inner Kitchen, and entered Zhang.
translations.idiomatic: It halted at Celestial Granary, crossed Outer Screen and Curled Tongue, entered the Purple Forbidden Enclosure, swept Wenchang, pointed at Inner Kitchen, and entered Extended Net.

sentences.zh: 七月乙亥灭。

translations.literal: Seventh month yihai, it vanished.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, yihai: it vanished.

sentences.zh: 十一年九月甲戌，有星见于五车东北，发芒丈余。

translations.literal: Year 11 ninth month jiaxu, a star appeared northeast of Five Chariots, rays extending more than a zhang.
translations.idiomatic: Hongwu 11, ninth month, jiaxu: a star appeared northeast of Five Chariots, its rays extending more than a zhang.

sentences.zh: 扫内阶，入紫微宫，扫北极五星，犯东垣少宰，入天市垣，犯天市。

translations.literal: It swept Inner Steps, entered the Purple Forbidden Palace, swept the Five Stars of the North Pole, transgressed the Eastern Rampart Lesser Steward, entered the Celestial Market Enclosure, and transgressed Celestial Market.
translations.idiomatic: It swept Inner Steps, entered the Purple Forbidden Palace, swept the Five Stars of the North Pole, transgressed the Eastern Rampart Lesser Steward, entered the Celestial Market Enclosure, and transgressed Celestial Market.

sentences.zh: 至十月己未，阴云不见。

translations.literal: By tenth month jiwei, overcast clouds—it was not seen.
translations.idiomatic: By tenth month, jiwei, overcast clouds hid it from view.

sentences.zh: 十八年九月戊寅，有星见太微垣，犯右执法，出端门。

translations.literal: Year 18 ninth month wuyin, a star appeared in the Supreme Palace Enclosure, transgressed the Right Law Administrator, and issued from Terminal Gate.
translations.idiomatic: Hongwu 18, ninth month, wuyin: a star appeared in the Supreme Palace Enclosure, transgressed the Right Law Administrator, and issued from Terminal Gate.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，入翼，彗长丈余。

translations.literal: On yiyou, it entered Wings; the comet was more than a zhang long.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou it entered Wings, the comet trailing more than a zhang.

sentences.zh: 至十月庚寅，犯军门，彗扫天庙。

translations.literal: By the tenth month, on gengyin, it transgressed Military Gate; the comet swept Heavenly Temple.
translations.idiomatic: By the tenth month, on gengyin, it struck Military Gate; the comet swept Heavenly Temple.

sentences.zh: 二十一年二月丙寅，有星出东壁，占曰“文士效用”。

translations.literal: Twenty-first year, second month, on bingyin, a star emerged from Eastern Wall; the prognostication read, "Men of letters will serve to effect."
translations.idiomatic: Hongwu 21, second month, bingyin: a star rose from Eastern Wall. The omen read, "Scholars will be put to use."

sentences.zh: 帝大喜，以为将策进士兆也。

translations.literal: The Emperor was greatly pleased, taking it as a portent that the metropolitan examination for advanced scholars was at hand.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor rejoiced, taking it as a sign that the jinshi examination was near.

sentences.zh: 永乐二年十月庚辰，辇道东南有星如盏，黄色，光润而不行。

translations.literal: Yongle second year, tenth month, on gengchen, southeast of Imperial Carriage Way there was a star like a wine cup, yellow, lustrous and motionless.
translations.idiomatic: Yongle 2, tenth month, gengchen: southeast of Imperial Carriage Way a star like a wine cup shone yellow, bright and still.

sentences.zh: 二十二年九月戊戌，有星见斗宿，大如碗，色黄白，光烛地，有声，如撒沙石。

translations.literal: Twenty-second year, ninth month, on xushu, a star appeared in Dipper; as large as a bowl, yellow-white, its light illuminating the ground, with a sound like scattering sand and stone.
translations.idiomatic: Yongle 22, ninth month, xushu: a star appeared in Dipper, bowl-sized and yellow-white, lighting the earth, with a sound like gravel flung abroad.

sentences.zh: 宣德五年八月庚寅，有星见南河旁，如弹丸大，色青黑，凡二十六日灭。

translations.literal: Xuande fifth year, eighth month, on gengyin, a star appeared beside Southern River, pellet-sized, blue-black; in all twenty-six days it vanished.
translations.idiomatic: Xuande 5, eighth month, gengyin: a pellet-sized blue-black star appeared by Southern River and was gone in twenty-six days.

sentences.zh: 十月丙申，蓬星见外屏南，东南行，经天仓、天庾，八日而灭。

translations.literal: Tenth month, on bingshen, a Peng star appeared south of Outer Screen, traveling southeast, passing Celestial Granary and Celestial Storehouse; in eight days it vanished.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, bingshen: a Peng star showed south of Outer Screen, moved southeast past Celestial Granary and Celestial Storehouse, and vanished in eight days.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁亥，有星如弹丸，见九斿旁，黄白光润，旬有五日而隐。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on dinghai, a star like a pellet appeared beside Nine Banners, yellow-white and lustrous; after fifteen days it hid.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, dinghai: a pellet-sized star, yellow-white and bright, appeared by Nine Banners and faded after fifteen days.

sentences.zh: 六年三月壬午，又见。

translations.literal: Sixth year, third month, on renwu, it appeared again.
translations.idiomatic: Xuande 6, third month, renwu: it appeared again.

sentences.zh: 八年闰八月戊午，景星三，见西北方天门，青赤黄各一，大如碗，明朗清润，良久聚半月形。

translations.literal: Eighth year, intercalary eighth month, on wuwu, three Auspicious Stars appeared at the northwestern Heavenly Gate, one each of blue, red, and yellow, as large as bowls, bright and clear; after long gathering they formed a half-moon.
translations.idiomatic: Xuande 8, intercalary eighth month, wuwu: three Auspicious Stars—blue, red, and yellow, each bowl-bright—showed at the northwestern Heavenly Gate, lingered, then gathered into a half-moon.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，有黄赤色见东南方，如星非星，如云非云，盖归邪星也。

translations.literal: On dingchou, yellow-red color appeared in the southeast, like a star yet not a star, like a cloud yet not a cloud—surely the Return-to-Evil star.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou a yellow-red glow rose in the southeast, starlike yet not a star, cloudlike yet not a cloud—the Return-to-Evil star.

sentences.zh: 景泰三年十一月癸未，有星见鬼宿积尸气旁，徐徐西行。

translations.literal: Jingtai third year, eleventh month, on guiwei, a star appeared beside the Corpse-Heap nebula in Ghost, slowly traveling west.
translations.idiomatic: Jingtai 3, eleventh month, guiwei: a star appeared by the Corpse-Heap nebula in Ghost and drifted slowly west.

sentences.zh: 天顺二年十一月癸卯，有星见于星宿，色白，西行，至丙午，其体微，状如粉絮，在轩辕旁。

translations.literal: Tianshun second year, eleventh month, on guimao, a star appeared in Star, white, traveling west; by bingwu its body was slight, like powdered floss, beside Xuanyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Tianshun 2, eleventh month, guimao: a white star appeared in Star and moved west; by bingwu it had thinned to powdered floss beside Xuanyuan.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，生芒五寸，犯爟位西北星，至十二月壬戌，没于东井。

translations.literal: On gengxu, rays five inches long grew; it transgressed the northwest star of Torch Stand, and by the twelfth month, on renxu, it vanished in Eastern Well.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu it sprouted five-inch rays and struck Torch Stand's northwest star; by the twelfth month, renxu, it was lost in Eastern Well.

sentences.zh: 五年六月壬辰，天市垣宗正旁，有星粉白，至乙未，化为白气而消。

translations.literal: Fifth year, sixth month, on renchen, beside Chancellor of the Ancestral Temple in the Celestial Market Enclosure, there was a powder-white star; by yiwei it turned into white vapor and dispersed.
translations.idiomatic: Tianshun 5, sixth month, renchen: a powder-white star stood by the Chancellor of the Ancestral Temple in the Celestial Market Enclosure; by yiwei it thinned to white vapor and vanished.

sentences.zh: 六年六月丙寅，有星见策星旁，色苍白，入紫微垣，犯天牢，至癸未，居中台下，形渐微。

translations.literal: Sixth year, sixth month, on bingyin, a star appeared beside Policy Star, pale white; it entered the Purple Forbidden Enclosure, transgressed Celestial Prison, and by guiwei was below Central Terrace, its form gradually slight.
translations.idiomatic: Tianshun 6, sixth month, bingyin: a pale star by Policy Star entered the Purple Forbidden Enclosure, struck Celestial Prison, and by guiwei hung faint below Central Terrace.

sentences.zh: 弘治三年十二月丁巳，有星见天市垣，东南行。

translations.literal: Hongzhi third year, twelfth month, on dingsi, a star appeared in the Celestial Market Enclosure, traveling southeast.
translations.idiomatic: Hongzhi 3, twelfth month, dingsi: a star appeared in the Celestial Market Enclosure and moved southeast.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，见天仓下，渐向壁。

translations.literal: On wuchen, it appeared below Celestial Granary, gradually turning toward Wall.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen it showed below Celestial Granary and drifted toward Wall.

sentences.zh: 七年十二月丙寅，有星见天江旁，徐行近斗，至八年正月庚戌，入危。

translations.literal: Seventh year, twelfth month, on bingyin, a star appeared beside Celestial River, slowly approaching Dipper; by the eighth year, first month, on gengxu, it entered Danger.
translations.idiomatic: Hongzhi 7, twelfth month, bingyin: a star by Celestial River crept toward Dipper; by the first month of the eighth year, gengxu, it entered Danger.

sentences.zh: 十二年七月戊辰，有星见天市垣宗星旁，入紫微垣东籓，经少宰、尚书，抵太子后宫，出西籓少辅旁，至八月己丑灭。

translations.literal: Twelfth year, seventh month, on wuchen, a star appeared beside the Ancestral Star in the Celestial Market Enclosure, entered the eastern rampart of the Purple Forbidden Enclosure, passed Lesser Steward and Minister, reached the crown prince's rear palace, emerged beside the western rampart's Lesser Assistant, and by the eighth month, on jichou, vanished.
translations.idiomatic: Hongzhi 12, seventh month, wuchen: a star by the Ancestral Star in the Celestial Market Enclosure entered the Purple Forbidden Enclosure's eastern rampart, threaded Lesser Steward and Minister, reached the crown prince's rear palace, left by the western rampart's Lesser Assistant, and vanished on jichou of the eighth month.

sentences.zh: 十五年十月戊辰，有星见天庙旁，自张抵翼，复退至张，戊寅灭。

translations.literal: Fifteenth year, tenth month, on wuchen, a star appeared beside Heavenly Temple, from Extended Net reaching Wings, then retreating to Extended Net; on wuyin it vanished.
translations.idiomatic: Hongzhi 15, tenth month, wuchen: a star by Heavenly Temple ran from Extended Net to Wings, fell back to Extended Net, and on wuyin was gone.

sentences.zh: 正德十六年正月甲寅朔，东南有星如火，变白，长可六七尺，横亘东西，复变勾屈状，良久乃散。

translations.literal: Zhengde sixteenth year, first month, new moon on jiayin, in the southeast there was a star like fire, turning white, six or seven chi long, stretching east and west, then changing to a hooked and bent shape; after long while it dispersed.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengde 16, first month, new moon jiayin: a firelike star in the southeast whitened, stretched six or seven chi east and west, curled into hooks, and at last scattered.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖八年正月立春日，长星亘天。

translations.literal: Jiajing eighth year, first month, on the day of Establishing the Sun, a long star spanned the sky.
translations.idiomatic: Jiajing 8, first month, Establishing the Sun day: a long star bridged the heavens.

sentences.zh: 七月又如之。

translations.literal: Seventh month, again it was so.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month it happened again.

sentences.zh: 十一年二月壬午，有星见东南，色苍白，有芒，积十九日灭。

translations.literal: Eleventh year, second month, on renwu, a star appeared in the southeast, pale white, with rays; after nineteen days it vanished.
translations.idiomatic: Jiajing 11, second month, renwu: a pale star with rays showed in the southeast and faded in nineteen days.

sentences.zh: 十三年五月丁卯朔，有星见螣蛇，历天厩入阁道，二十四日灭。

translations.literal: Thirteenth year, fifth month, new moon on dingmao, a star appeared in Serpent, passed Heavenly Stables and entered Flying Gallery; in twenty-four days it vanished.
translations.idiomatic: Jiajing 13, fifth month, new moon dingmao: a star in Serpent crossed Heavenly Stables, entered Flying Gallery, and was gone in twenty-four days.

sentences.zh: 十五年三月戊午，有星见天棓旁，东行历天厨，西入天汉，至四月壬辰没。

translations.literal: Fifteenth year, third month, on wuwu, a star appeared beside Celestial Rope, traveling east past Celestial Kitchen, entering Celestial Han; by the fourth month, on renchen, it vanished.
translations.idiomatic: Jiajing 15, third month, wuwu: a star by Celestial Rope moved east past Celestial Kitchen into Celestial Han and vanished on renchen of the fourth month.

sentences.zh: 二十四年十一月壬午，有星出天棓，入箕，转东北行，逾月没。

translations.literal: Twenty-fourth year, eleventh month, on renwu, a star emerged from Celestial Rope, entered Winnowing Basket, turned northeast, and after more than a month vanished.
translations.idiomatic: Jiajing 24, eleventh month, renwu: a star rose from Celestial Rope, entered Winnowing Basket, turned northeast, and was lost after more than a month.

sentences.zh: 万历六年正月戊辰，有大星如日，出自西方，众星皆西环。

translations.literal: Wanli sixth year, first month, on wuchen, a great star like the sun emerged from the west; all the stars ringed it to the west.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 6, first month, wuchen: a sun-bright star rose in the west and the host of stars wheeled west around it.

sentences.zh: 十二年六月己酉，有星出房。

translations.literal: Twelfth year, sixth month, on jiyou, a star emerged from Room.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 12, sixth month, jiyou: a star rose from Room.

sentences.zh: 三十二年九月乙丑，尾分有星如弹丸，色赤黄，见西南方，至十月而隐。

translations.literal: Thirty-second year, ninth month, on yichou, in the Tail allotment a star like a pellet, red-yellow, appeared in the southwest; by the tenth month it hid.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 32, ninth month, yichou: a red-yellow pellet-star in the Tail allotment showed in the southwest and hid in the tenth month.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛酉，转出东南方，仍尾分。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on xinyou, it shifted out to the southeast, still in the Tail allotment.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, xinyou: it swung out to the southeast, still within Tail.

sentences.zh: 明年二月渐暗，八月丁卯始灭。

translations.literal: The next year, second month it gradually dimmed; eighth month, on dingmao, it finally vanished.
translations.idiomatic: The next year it dimmed through the second month; on dingmao of the eighth month it vanished at last.

sentences.zh: 三十七年，有大星见西南，芒刺四射。

translations.literal: Thirty-seventh year, a great star appeared in the southwest, rays stabbing in four directions.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 37: a great star blazed in the southwest, rays thrusting four ways.

sentences.zh: 四十六年九月乙卯，东南有白气一道，阔尺余，长二丈余，东至轸，西入翼，十九日而灭。

translations.literal: Forty-sixth year, ninth month, on yimao, in the southeast there was a white vapor one path, more than a chi wide and two zhang long, east to Chariot and west into Wings; in nineteen days it vanished.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 46, ninth month, yimao: a white vapor a chi wide and two zhang long ran southeast from Chariot into Wings and dispersed in nineteen days.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙寅，旦有花白星见东方。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on bingyin, at dawn a mottled white star appeared in the east.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, bingyin: at dawn a mottled white star showed in the east.

sentences.zh: 天启元年四月癸酉，赤星见于东方。

translations.literal: Tianqi first year, fourth month, on guiyou, a red star appeared in the east.
translations.idiomatic: Tianqi 1, fourth month, guiyou: a red star appeared in the east.

sentences.zh: 崇祯九年冬，天狗见豫分。

translations.literal: Chongzhen ninth year, winter, the Heavenly Dog appeared in the Yu allotment.
translations.idiomatic: Chongzhen 9, winter: the Heavenly Dog showed in the Yu allotment.

sentences.zh: ▲彗孛

translations.literal: ▲ Comets and broom stars.
translations.idiomatic: ▲ Comets and broom stars.

sentences.zh: 彗之光芒傅日而生，故夕见者必东指，晨见者必西指。

translations.literal: A comet's radiance is born by adhering to the sun; therefore when seen at dusk it must point east, and when seen at dawn it must point west.
translations.idiomatic: A comet's light clings to the sun: seen at dusk it must point east; seen at dawn, west.

sentences.zh: 孛亦彗类，其芒气四出，天文家言其灾更甚于彗。

translations.literal: A broom star is also of the comet kind; its rayed vapor spreads in four directions. Astronomers say its calamity is even graver than a comet's.
translations.idiomatic: The broom star too belongs to the comet kind, its haze shooting four ways; astronomers hold its disaster graver still than a comet's.

sentences.zh: 洪武元年正月庚寅，彗星见于昴、毕。

translations.literal: Hongwu first year, first month, on gengyin, a comet appeared in Hairy Head and Net.
translations.idiomatic: Hongwu 1, first month, gengyin: a comet appeared in Hairy Head and Net.

sentences.zh: 三月辛卯，彗星出昴北大陵、天船间，长八尺余，指文昌，近五车，四月己酉，没于五车北。

translations.literal: Third month, on xinmao, a comet emerged between Great Mound north of Hairy Head and Celestial Boat, more than eight chi long, pointing at Wenchang, near Five Chariots; fourth month, on jiyou, it vanished north of Five Chariots.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, xinmao: a comet rose between Great Mound north of Hairy Head and Celestial Boat, eight chi long, aimed at Wenchang and Five Chariots; on jiyou of the fourth month it died north of Five Chariots.

sentences.zh: 六年四月，彗星三入紫微垣。

translations.literal: Sixth year, fourth month, three comets entered the Purple Forbidden Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: Hongwu 6, fourth month: three comets entered the Purple Forbidden Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 二十四年四月丙子，彗星二，一入紫微垣阊阖门，犯天床；

translations.literal: Twenty-fourth year, fourth month, on bingzi, two comets—one entered the Purple Forbidden Enclosure's Changhe Gate, transgressing Celestial Bed;
translations.idiomatic: Hongwu 24, fourth month, bingzi: two comets—one entered the Purple Forbidden Enclosure's Changhe Gate and struck Celestial Bed;

sentences.zh: 一犯六甲，扫五帝内座。

translations.literal: one transgressed Six Jia, sweeping the Inner Seat of the Five Emperors.
translations.idiomatic: the other struck Six Jia and swept the Inner Seat of the Five Emperors.

sentences.zh: 永乐五年十一月丙寅，彗星见。

translations.literal: Yongle fifth year, eleventh month, on bingyin, a comet appeared.
translations.idiomatic: Yongle 5, eleventh month, bingyin: a comet appeared.

sentences.zh: 宣德六年四月戊戌，有星孛于东井，长五尺余。

translations.literal: Xuande sixth year, fourth month, on xushu, a broom star was at Eastern Well, more than five chi long.
translations.idiomatic: Xuande 6, fourth month, xushu: a broom star stood in Eastern Well, five chi long.

sentences.zh: 七年正月壬戌，彗星出东方，长丈余，尾扫天津，东南行，十月始灭。

translations.literal: Seventh year, first month, on renxu, a comet emerged in the east, more than a zhang long, its tail sweeping Celestial Ford, traveling southeast; in the tenth month it first vanished.
translations.idiomatic: Xuande 7, first month, renxu: a comet rose in the east, a zhang long, its tail sweeping Celestial Ford southeastward; it faded in the tenth month.

sentences.zh: 是月戊子，又出西方，十有七日而灭。

translations.literal: That month, on wuzi, it again emerged in the west; in seventeen days it vanished.
translations.idiomatic: That month, wuzi: it showed again in the west and was gone in seventeen days.

sentences.zh: 八年闰八月壬子，彗星出天仓旁，长丈许。

translations.literal: Eighth year, intercalary eighth month, on renzi, a comet emerged beside Celestial Granary, about a zhang long.
translations.idiomatic: Xuande 8, intercalary eighth month, renzi: a comet rose by Celestial Granary, about a zhang long.

sentences.zh: 己巳，入贯索，扫七公。

translations.literal: On jisi, it entered Coiled Thong, sweeping Seven Lords.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi it entered Coiled Thong and swept Seven Lords.

sentences.zh: 己卯，复入天市垣，扫晋星，二十有四日而灭。

translations.literal: On jimao, it again entered the Celestial Market Enclosure, sweeping the Jin stars; in twenty-four days it vanished.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao it re-entered the Celestial Market Enclosure, swept the Jin stars, and vanished in twenty-four days.

sentences.zh: 正统四年闰二月己丑，彗星见张宿旁，大如弹。

translations.literal: Zhengtong fourth year, intercalary second month, on jichou, a comet appeared beside Extended Net, as large as a pellet.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengtong 4, intercalary second month, jichou: a pellet-sized comet appeared by Extended Net.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，长五丈余，西行，扫酒旗，迤北，犯鬼宿。

translations.literal: On dingyou, more than five zhang long, traveling west, sweeping Wine Banner, winding north, transgressing Ghost.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou it stretched five zhang, swept west through Wine Banner, curved north, and struck Ghost.

sentences.zh: 六月戊寅，彗星见毕宿旁，长丈余，指西南，计五十有五日乃灭。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on wuyin, a comet appeared beside Net, more than a zhang long, pointing southwest; in all fifty-five days it then vanished.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, wuyin: a comet by Net, a zhang long and pointing southwest, lasted fifty-five days and vanished.

sentences.zh: 九年七月庚午，彗星见太微东垣，长丈许，累日渐长，至闰七月己卯，入角没。

translations.literal: Ninth year, seventh month, on gengwu, a comet appeared at the eastern rampart of Supreme Palace Enclosure, about a zhang long, day by day gradually lengthening; by intercalary seventh month, on jimao, it entered Horn and vanished.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengtong 9, seventh month, gengwu: a comet at the Supreme Palace Enclosure's eastern rampart, a zhang at first and lengthening daily; on jimao of the intercalary seventh month it entered Horn and died.

sentences.zh: 十四年十二月壬子，彗星见天市垣市楼旁，历尾度，长二尺余，至乙亥没。

translations.literal: Fourteenth year, twelfth month, on renzi, a comet appeared beside Market Tower in the Celestial Market Enclosure, passing the Tail degrees, more than two chi long; by yihai it vanished.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengtong 14, twelfth month, renzi: a comet by Market Tower in the Celestial Market Enclosure crossed the Tail degrees, two chi long, and vanished on yihai.

sentences.zh: 景泰元年正月壬午，彗星出天市垣外，扫天纪星。

translations.literal: Jingtai first year, first month, on renwu, a comet emerged outside the Celestial Market Enclosure, sweeping the Celestial Law star.
translations.idiomatic: Jingtai 1, first month, renwu: a comet rose outside the Celestial Market Enclosure and swept Celestial Law.

sentences.zh: 三年三月甲午朔，有星孛于毕。

translations.literal: Third year, third month, new moon on jiawu, a broom star was at Net.
translations.idiomatic: Jingtai 3, third month, new moon jiawu: a broom star stood at Net.

sentences.zh: 七年四月壬戌，彗星东北见于胃，长二尺，指西南。

translations.literal: Seventh year, fourth month, on renxu, a comet appeared in the northeast at Stomach, two chi long, pointing southwest.
translations.idiomatic: Jingtai 7, fourth month, renxu: a comet showed northeast at Stomach, two chi long, tail to the southwest.

sentences.zh: 五月癸酉，渐长丈余。

translations.literal: Fifth month, on guiyou, it gradually lengthened to more than a zhang.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, guiyou: it slowly stretched past a zhang.

sentences.zh: 戊子，西北见于柳，长九尺余，扫犯轩辕星。

translations.literal: On wuzi, in the northwest it appeared at Willow, more than nine chi long, sweeping and transgressing Xuanyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi it blazed northwest at Willow, nine chi long, sweeping Xuanyuan.

sentences.zh: 甲午，见于张，长七尺余，扫太微北，西南行。

translations.literal: On jiawu, it appeared at Extended Net, more than seven chi long, sweeping north of Supreme Palace Enclosure, traveling southwest.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu it showed at Extended Net, seven chi long, swept north of the Supreme Palace Enclosure, and ran southwest.

sentences.zh: 六月壬寅，入太微垣，长尺余。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on renyin, it entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure, one chi long.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, renyin: it entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure, a chi long.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲寅，彗星复见于毕，长五寸，东南行，渐长，至癸亥而没。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on jiayin, the comet again appeared at Net, five inches long, traveling southeast, gradually lengthening; by guihai it vanished.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, jiayin: the comet returned at Net, five inches long, lengthened as it ran southeast, and vanished on guihai.

sentences.zh: 天顺元年五月丙戌，彗星见于危，若动摇者，东行一度，芒长五寸，指西南。

translations.literal: Tianshun first year, fifth month, on bingxu, a comet appeared at Danger, as if swaying, traveling one degree east, rays five inches long, pointing southwest.
translations.idiomatic: Tianshun 1, fifth month, bingxu: a comet at Danger swayed east one degree, five-inch rays pointing southwest.

sentences.zh: 六月癸巳朔，见室，长丈余，由尾至东壁，犯天大将军、卷舌第三星，井宿水位南第二星。

translations.literal: Sixth month, new moon on guisi, it appeared at Encampment, more than a zhang long, from Tail to Eastern Wall, transgressing Great Celestial General and the third star of Curled Tongue, and the second star south of Well's Water Level.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, new moon guisi: it showed at Encampment, a zhang long from Tail to Eastern Wall, striking Great Celestial General, Curled Tongue's third star, and the second star south of Well's Water Level.

sentences.zh: 十月己亥，彗星见于角，长五寸余，指北，犯角北星及平道东星。

translations.literal: Tenth month, on jihai, a comet appeared at Horn, more than five inches long, pointing north, transgressing Horn's north star and the eastern star of Level Path.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, jihai: a comet at Horn, five inches long, pointed north and struck Horn's north star and Level Path's eastern star.

sentences.zh: 五年六月戊戌，彗见东方，指西南，入井度。

translations.literal: Fifth year, sixth month, on xushu, a comet appeared in the east, pointing southwest, entering the Well degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Tianshun 5, sixth month, xushu: a comet in the east pointed southwest into the Well degrees.

sentences.zh: 七月丙寅始灭。

translations.literal: Seventh month, on bingyin, it first vanished.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, bingyin: it vanished at last.

sentences.zh: 成化元年二月，彗星见。

translations.literal: Chenghua first year, second month, a comet appeared.
translations.idiomatic: Chenghua 1, second month: a comet appeared.

sentences.zh: 三月，又见西北，长三丈余，三阅月而没。

translations.literal: Third month, it again appeared in the northwest, more than three zhang long; after three months it vanished.
translations.idiomatic: Third month: it showed again in the northwest, three zhang long, and was gone after three months.

sentences.zh: 四年九月己未，有星见星五度，东北行，越五日，芒长三丈余，尾指西南，变为彗星。

translations.literal: Fourth year, ninth month, on jiwei, a star appeared at five degrees of Star, traveling northeast; after five days rays were three zhang long, tail pointing southwest, changing into a comet.
translations.idiomatic: Chenghua 4, ninth month, jiwei: a star at five degrees of Star moved northeast; in five days its rays reached three zhang, tail southwest, and it became a comet.

sentences.zh: 其后晨见东方，昏见室，南犯三公、北斗、瑶光、七公，转入天市垣。

translations.literal: Afterward seen at dawn in the east, at dusk in Encampment, south transgressing Three Excellencies, Northern Dipper, Jade Radiance, and Seven Lords, then entering the Celestial Market Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter it showed at dawn in the east and at dusk in Encampment, struck south through Three Excellencies, Northern Dipper, Jade Radiance, and Seven Lords, and entered the Celestial Market Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 出垣渐小，犯天屏西第一星。

translations.literal: Emerging from the enclosure it gradually diminished, transgressing the first star west of Heavenly Screen.
translations.idiomatic: Leaving the enclosure it waned and struck the first star west of Heavenly Screen.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚辰，始灭。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on gengchen, it first vanished.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, gengchen: it vanished at last.

sentences.zh: 七年十二月甲戌，彗星见天田，西指，寻北行，犯右摄提，扫太微垣上将及幸臣、太子、从官，尾指正西，横扫太微垣郎位。

translations.literal: Seventh year, twelfth month, on jiaxu, a comet appeared at Celestial Field, pointing west; soon traveling north, it transgressed Right Rearward, sweeping the Supreme Palace Enclosure's supreme general, favored ministers, crown prince, and attendants; its tail pointed due west, broadly sweeping the Supreme Palace Enclosure's courtier stations.
translations.idiomatic: Chenghua 7, twelfth month, jiaxu: a comet at Celestial Field pointed west, then ran north, struck Right Rearward, and swept the Supreme Palace Enclosure's supreme general, favored ministers, crown prince, and attendants; its tail swept due west through the courtier stations.

sentences.zh: 己卯，光芒长大，东西竟天。

translations.literal: On jimao, its radiance grew long, spanning east and west across the sky.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao its light swelled until it bridged the sky east and west.

sentences.zh: 北行二十八度余，犯天枪，扫北斗、三公、太阳，入紫微垣内，正昼犹见。

translations.literal: Traveling north more than twenty-eight degrees, it transgressed Heavenly Spear, sweeping Northern Dipper, Three Excellencies, and the Sun, entering within the Purple Forbidden Enclosure—visible even at noon.
translations.idiomatic: It ran north twenty-eight degrees and more, struck Heavenly Spear, swept Northern Dipper, Three Excellencies, and the Sun, entered the Purple Forbidden Enclosure, and shone even at noon.

sentences.zh: 自帝星、北斗、魁、庶子、后宫、勾陈、天枢、三师、天牢、中台、天皇大帝、上卫、阁道、文昌、上台，无所不犯。

translations.literal: From the Emperor Star, Northern Dipper, Dipper Sceptre, Heir Apparent's Son, Rear Palace, Gouchen, Celestial Pivot, Three Preceptors, Celestial Prison, Central Terrace, Great Celestial Emperor, Upper Guard, Flying Gallery, Wenchang, and Upper Terrace—it transgressed none it did not reach.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Star, Northern Dipper, Dipper Sceptre, Heir Apparent's Son, Rear Palace, Gouchen, Celestial Pivot, Three Preceptors, Celestial Prison, Central Terrace, Great Celestial Emperor, Upper Guard, Flying Gallery, Wenchang, Upper Terrace—it spared none.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，南行犯娄、天河、天阴、外屏、天囷。

translations.literal: On yiyou, traveling south it transgressed Bond, Celestial River, Celestial Yin, Outer Screen, and Celestial Storehouse.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou it turned south through Bond, Celestial River, Celestial Yin, Outer Screen, and Celestial Storehouse.

sentences.zh: 八年正月丙午，行奎宿外屏，渐微，久之始灭。

translations.literal: Eighth year, first month, on bingwu, it passed outside the Outer Screen of Kui, gradually slight; after long while it first vanished.
translations.idiomatic: Chenghua 8, first month, bingwu: it skirted Kui's Outer Screen, thinned, and after long while vanished.

sentences.zh: 弘治三年十一月戊戌，彗星见天津南，尾指东北。

translations.literal: Hongzhi third year, eleventh month, on xushu, a comet appeared south of Celestial Ford, tail pointing northeast.
translations.idiomatic: Hongzhi 3, eleventh month, xushu: a comet south of Celestial Ford pointed its tail northeast.

sentences.zh: 犯人星，历杵臼。

translations.literal: It transgressed Man Star, passing Pestle and Mortar.
translations.idiomatic: It struck Man Star and crossed Pestle and Mortar.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊申朔，入营室。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, new moon on wushen, it entered Encampment Chamber.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, new moon wushen: it entered Encampment Chamber.

sentences.zh: 庚申，犯天仓。

translations.literal: On gengshen, it transgressed Celestial Granary.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen it struck Celestial Granary.

sentences.zh: 十三年四月甲午，彗星见垒壁阵上，入室壁间，渐长三尺余。

translations.literal: Thirteenth year, fourth month, on jiawu, a comet appeared atop Rampart Formation, between Room and Wall, gradually lengthening to more than three chi.
translations.idiomatic: Hongzhi 13, fourth month, jiawu: a comet atop Rampart Formation, between Room and Wall, slowly stretched past three chi.

sentences.zh: 指离宫，扫造父，过太微垣，渐微。

translations.literal: Pointing at Lixing Palace, sweeping Zaosu, passing the Supreme Palace Enclosure, gradually slight.
translations.idiomatic: It aimed at Lixing Palace, swept Zaosu, crossed the Supreme Palace Enclosure, and waned.

sentences.zh: 入紫微垣，近女史，犯尚书，六月丁酉没。

translations.literal: Entering the Purple Forbidden Enclosure, nearing Female Clerk, transgressing Minister; sixth month, on dingyou, it vanished.
translations.idiomatic: It entered the Purple Forbidden Enclosure, neared Female Clerk, struck Minister, and on dingyou of the sixth month vanished.

sentences.zh: 正德元年七月己丑，有星见紫微西籓外，如弹丸，色苍白。

translations.literal: Zhengde first year, seventh month, on jichou, a star appeared outside the western rampart of the Purple Forbidden Enclosure, like a pellet, pale white.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengde 1, seventh month, jichou: a pellet-sized pale star appeared outside the Purple Forbidden Enclosure's western rampart.

sentences.zh: 越数日，有微芒见参、井间，渐长二尺，如帚，西北至文昌。

translations.literal: After several days, slight rays appeared between Net and Well, gradually lengthening to two chi like a broom, northwest to Wenchang.
translations.idiomatic: Days later faint rays showed between Net and Well, lengthened to a two-chi broom, and ran northwest to Wenchang.

sentences.zh: 庚子，彗星见，有光，流东南，长三尺。

translations.literal: On gengzi, a comet appeared, with light, streaming southeast, three chi long.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi a comet blazed, streaming three chi southeast.

sentences.zh: 越三日，长五尺许，扫下台上星，入太微垣。

translations.literal: After three days, more than five chi long, sweeping the upper star of Lower Terrace, entering the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: In three days it stretched five chi, swept Lower Terrace's upper star, and entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 十五年正月，彗星见。

translations.literal: Fifteenth year, first month, a comet appeared.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengde 15, first month: a comet appeared.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖二年六月，有星孛于天市。

translations.literal: Jiajing second year, sixth month, a broom star was at the Celestial Market.
translations.idiomatic: Jiajing 2, sixth month: a broom star stood in the Celestial Market.

sentences.zh: 十年闰六月乙巳，彗星见于东井，长尺余，扫轩辕第一星。

translations.literal: Tenth year, intercalary sixth month, on yisi, a comet appeared at Eastern Well, more than a chi long, sweeping the first star of Xuanyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Jiajing 10, intercalary sixth month, yisi: a comet at Eastern Well, a chi long, swept Xuanyuan's first star.

sentences.zh: 芒渐长，至翼，长七尺余。

translations.literal: Its rays gradually lengthened; reaching Wings, it was more than seven chi long.
translations.idiomatic: Its rays lengthened; by Wings it measured seven chi.

sentences.zh: 东北扫天樽，入太微垣，扫郎位，行角度，东南扫亢北第二星，渐敛，积三十四日而没。

translations.literal: Northeast it swept Heavenly Wine Jar, entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure, swept courtier stations, traveled degree by degree, southeast sweeping the second star north of Horn, gradually contracting; in all thirty-four days it vanished.
translations.idiomatic: Northeast it swept Heavenly Wine Jar, entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure, swept the courtier stations, turned southeast past Horn's second star north, slowly contracted, and vanished in thirty-four days.

sentences.zh: 十一年八月己卯，彗星见东井，长尺许。

translations.literal: Year 11, eighth month, day jimao, a comet appeared at Well, about a foot long.
translations.idiomatic: Jiajing 11, eighth month, jimao: a comet appeared at Well, about a foot long.

sentences.zh: 后东北行，历天津，渐至丈余。

translations.literal: Afterward it went northeast, passing Celestial Ford, gradually reaching more than a zhang.
translations.idiomatic: It then moved northeast, passing Celestial Ford, and gradually lengthened to more than a zhang.

sentences.zh: 扫太微垣诸星及角宿、天门，至十二月甲戌，凡一百十五日而灭。

translations.literal: It swept stars of the Taiwei Enclosure and of Horn mansion and Celestial Gate; until the twelfth month, day jiaxu, altogether one hundred fifteen days, then it vanished.
translations.idiomatic: It swept stars of the Taiwei Enclosure, Horn, and Celestial Gate; on the twelfth month, jiaxu, after one hundred fifteen days in all, it vanished.

sentences.zh: 十二年六月辛巳，彗星见于五车，长五尺余，扫大陵及天大将军。

translations.literal: Year 12, sixth month, day xinsi, a comet appeared at the Five Chariots, more than five chi long, sweeping Great Tomb and the Great General of Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Jiajing 12, sixth month, xinsi: a comet appeared at the Five Chariots, more than five chi long, sweeping Great Tomb and the Great General of Heaven.

sentences.zh: 渐长丈余，扫阁道，犯螣蛇，至八月戊戌而灭。

translations.literal: It gradually lengthened to more than a zhang, swept the Gallery Bridge, encroached upon Flying Serpent, and vanished on the eighth month, day wuxu.
translations.idiomatic: It gradually lengthened to more than a zhang, swept the Gallery Bridge, encroached upon Flying Serpent, and vanished on the eighth month, wuxu.

sentences.zh: 十八年四月庚戌，彗星见，长三尺许，光指东南。

translations.literal: Year 18, fourth month, day gengxu, a comet appeared, about three chi long, its light pointing southeast.
translations.idiomatic: Jiajing 18, fourth month, gengxu: a comet appeared, about three chi long, its light pointing southeast.

sentences.zh: 扫轩辕北第八星，旬日始灭。

translations.literal: It swept the eighth star north of Xuanyuan; after ten days it vanished.
translations.idiomatic: It swept the eighth star north of Xuanyuan; after ten days it vanished.

sentences.zh: 三十三年五月癸亥，彗星见天权旁，犯文昌，行入近浊，积二十七日而没。

translations.literal: Year 33, fifth month, day guihai, a comet appeared beside Celestial Balance, encroached upon Wenchang, entered Near Turbid, and after twenty-seven days vanished.
translations.idiomatic: Jiajing 33, fifth month, guihai: a comet appeared beside Celestial Balance, encroached upon Wenchang, entered Near Turbid, and vanished after twenty-seven days.

sentences.zh: 三十五年正月庚辰，彗星见进贤旁，长尺许，西南指，渐至三尺余。

translations.literal: Year 35, first month, day gengchen, a comet appeared beside Advancement of the Worthies, about a foot long, pointing southwest; it gradually reached more than three chi.
translations.idiomatic: Jiajing 35, first month, gengchen: a comet appeared beside Advancement of the Worthies, about a foot long and pointing southwest; it gradually lengthened to more than three chi.

sentences.zh: 扫太微垣，次相东北，入紫微垣，犯天床，四月二日灭。

translations.literal: It swept the Taiwei Enclosure, next went northeast, entered the Purple Forbidden Enclosure, encroached upon the Celestial Bed, and vanished on the second day of the fourth month.
translations.idiomatic: It swept the Taiwei Enclosure, then turned northeast into the Purple Forbidden Enclosure and encroached upon the Celestial Bed; it vanished on the second day of the fourth month.

sentences.zh: 三十六年九月戊辰，彗星见天市垣列肆旁，东北指，至十月二十三日灭。

translations.literal: Year 36, ninth month, day wuchen, a comet appeared beside Row of Shops in the Celestial Market Enclosure, pointing northeast; it vanished on the twenty-third day of the tenth month.
translations.idiomatic: Jiajing 36, ninth month, wuchen: a comet appeared beside Row of Shops in the Celestial Market Enclosure, pointing northeast; it vanished on the twenty-third day of the tenth month.

sentences.zh: 隆庆三年十月辛丑朔，彗星见天市垣，东北指，至庚申灭。

translations.literal: Longqing year 3, tenth month, new moon on xinchou, a comet appeared in the Celestial Market Enclosure, pointing northeast; it vanished on gengshen.
translations.idiomatic: Longqing 3, tenth month, new moon on xinchou: a comet appeared in the Celestial Market Enclosure, pointing northeast; it vanished on gengshen.

sentences.zh: 万历五年十月戊子，彗星见西南，苍白色，长数丈，气成白虹。

translations.literal: Wanli year 5, tenth month, day wuzi, a comet appeared in the southwest, pale white, several zhang long; its vapour formed a white rainbow.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 5, tenth month, wuzi: a comet appeared in the southwest, pale white and several zhang long; its vapour formed a white rainbow.

sentences.zh: 由尾、箕越斗、牛逼女，经月而灭。

translations.literal: From Tail and Winnowing Basket it crossed Dipper and Ox and Maiden; after a month it vanished.
translations.idiomatic: It passed from Tail and Winnowing Basket across Dipper and Ox and Maiden; after a month it vanished.

sentences.zh: 八年八月庚申，彗星见东南方，每夜渐长，纵横河汉凡七十日有奇。

translations.literal: Year 8, eighth month, day gengshen, a comet appeared in the southeast; each night it gradually lengthened, crossing the River of Heaven for more than seventy days.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 8, eighth month, gengshen: a comet appeared in the southeast; each night it gradually lengthened, crossing the River of Heaven for more than seventy days.

sentences.zh: 十年四月丙辰，彗星见西北，形如匹练，尾指五车，历二十余日灭。

translations.literal: Year 10, fourth month, day bingchen, a comet appeared in the northwest, shaped like a bolt of silk, its tail pointing at the Five Chariots; after more than twenty days it vanished.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 10, fourth month, bingchen: a comet appeared in the northwest, shaped like a bolt of silk with its tail pointing at the Five Chariots; after more than twenty days it vanished.

sentences.zh: 十三年九月戊子，彗星出羽林旁，长尺许。

translations.literal: Year 13, ninth month, day wuzi, a comet issued beside the Feathered Forest, about a foot long.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 13, ninth month, wuzi: a comet issued beside the Feathered Forest, about a foot long.

sentences.zh: 每夕东行，渐小，至十月癸酉灭。

translations.literal: Each evening it went east and gradually shrank; on the tenth month, day guiyou, it vanished.
translations.idiomatic: Each evening it moved eastward and gradually shrank; on the tenth month, guiyou, it vanished.

sentences.zh: 十九年三月丙辰，西北有星如彗，长尺余。

translations.literal: Year 19, third month, day bingchen, in the northwest there was a star like a comet, more than a foot long.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 19, third month, bingchen: in the northwest a star like a comet appeared, more than a foot long.

sentences.zh: 历胃、室、壁，长二尺。

translations.literal: It passed Stomach, Encampment, and Wall; its length was two chi.
translations.idiomatic: It passed Stomach, Encampment, and Wall; its length reached two chi.

sentences.zh: 闰三月丙寅朔，入娄。

translations.literal: Intercalary third month, new moon on bingyin, it entered Bond.
translations.idiomatic: On the intercalary third month, new moon on bingyin, it entered Bond.

sentences.zh: 二十一年七月乙卯，彗星见东井。

translations.literal: Year 21, seventh month, day yimao, a comet appeared at Well.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 21, seventh month, yimao: a comet appeared at Well.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，逆行入紫微垣，犯华盖。

translations.literal: On yihai it moved retrograde into the Purple Forbidden Enclosure and encroached upon the Canopy of Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai it moved retrograde into the Purple Forbidden Enclosure and encroached upon the Canopy of Heaven.

sentences.zh: 二十四年七月丁丑，彗星见西北，如弹丸。

translations.literal: Year 24, seventh month, day dingchou, a comet appeared in the northwest like a pellet.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 24, seventh month, dingchou: a comet appeared in the northwest like a pellet.

sentences.zh: 入翼，长尺余，西北行。

translations.literal: It entered Wings, was more than a foot long, and moved northwest.
translations.idiomatic: It entered Wings, was more than a foot long, and moved northwest.

sentences.zh: 三十五年八月辛酉朔，彗星见东井，指西南，渐往西北。

translations.literal: Year 35, eighth month, new moon on xinyou, a comet appeared at Well, pointing southwest, gradually going toward the northwest.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 35, eighth month, new moon on xinyou: a comet appeared at Well, pointing southwest and gradually shifting toward the northwest.

sentences.zh: 壬午，自房历心灭。

translations.literal: On renwu it passed from Room through Heart and vanished.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu it passed from Room through Heart and vanished.

sentences.zh: 四十六年十月乙丑，彗星出于氐，长丈余，指东南，渐指西北。

translations.literal: Year 46, tenth month, day yichou, a comet issued from Root, more than a zhang long, pointing southeast, gradually pointing northwest.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 46, tenth month, yichou: a comet issued from Root, more than a zhang long, at first pointing southeast and gradually turning northwest.

sentences.zh: 扫犯太阳守星，入亢度，西北扫北斗、璇玑、文昌、五车，逼紫微垣右，至十一月甲辰灭。

translations.literal: It swept and encroached upon the Guardian of the Sun, entered the degrees of Neck, swept northwest past the Northern Dipper, Sighting Axis, Wenchang, and the Five Chariots, pressing the right side of the Purple Forbidden Enclosure; it vanished on the eleventh month, day jiachen.
translations.idiomatic: It swept and encroached upon the Guardian of the Sun, entered Neck, and swept northwest past the Northern Dipper, Sighting Axis, Wenchang, and the Five Chariots, pressing the right side of the Purple Forbidden Enclosure; it vanished on the eleventh month, jiachen.

sentences.zh: 四十七年正月杪，彗见东南，长数百尺，光芒下射，末曲而锐，未几见于东北，又未几见于西。

translations.literal: Year 47, at the end of the first month, a comet appeared in the southeast, several hundred chi long; its radiance shot downward, its tip curved and sharp; before long it was seen in the northeast, and before long in the west.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 47, at the end of the first month: a comet appeared in the southeast, several hundred chi long, its radiance shooting downward and its tip curved and sharp; before long it was seen in the northeast, and before long in the west.

sentences.zh: 崇祯十二年秋，彗星见参分。

translations.literal: Chongzhen year 12, autumn, a comet appeared at the Three Stars.
translations.idiomatic: Chongzhen 12, autumn: a comet appeared at the Three Stars.

sentences.zh: 十三年十月丙戌，彗星见。

translations.literal: Year 13, tenth month, day bingxu, a comet appeared.
translations.idiomatic: Chongzhen 13, tenth month, bingxu: a comet appeared.

sentences.zh: ▲天变

translations.literal: ▲ Heavenly transformations.
translations.idiomatic: ▲ Heavenly transformations.

sentences.zh: 洪武二十一年八月壬戌至甲子，天鼓鸣，昼夜不止。

translations.literal: Hongwu year 21, eighth month, from renxu to jiazi, the sky drum sounded day and night without cease.
translations.idiomatic: Hongwu 21, eighth month, from renxu to jiazi: the sky drum sounded day and night without cease.

sentences.zh: 二十八年三月戊午，昏刻天鸣，如风水相搏，至一鼓止。

translations.literal: Year 28, third month, day wuwu, at the dusk watch the sky sounded like wind and water clashing; it stopped at the first watch.
translations.idiomatic: Hongwu 28, third month, wuwu: at the dusk watch the sky sounded like wind and water clashing; it stopped at the first watch.

sentences.zh: 九月戊戌，初鼓，天鸣如泻水，自东北而南，至二鼓止。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day wuxu, at the first watch the sky sounded like pouring water, from the northeast toward the south; it stopped at the second watch.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, wuxu: at the first watch the sky sounded like pouring water, from the northeast toward the south; it stopped at the second watch.

sentences.zh: 宣德元年八月戊辰，昏刻天鸣，如雨阵迭至，自东南而西南，良久乃息。

translations.literal: Xuande year 1, eighth month, day wuchen, at the dusk watch the sky sounded like rain squalls arriving in succession, from the southeast toward the southwest; after a long while it ceased.
translations.idiomatic: Xuande 1, eighth month, wuchen: at the dusk watch the sky sounded like rain squalls arriving in succession, from the southeast toward the southwest; after a long while it ceased.

sentences.zh: 辛未，东南天鸣，声如万鼓。

translations.literal: On xinwei the southeast sky sounded like ten thousand drums.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei the southeast sky sounded like ten thousand drums.

sentences.zh: 正统十年三月庚寅，西北天鸣，如鸟群飞。

translations.literal: Zhengtong year 10, third month, day gengyin, the northwest sky sounded like a flock of birds in flight.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengtong 10, third month, gengyin: the northwest sky sounded like a flock of birds in flight.

sentences.zh: 正德元年二月壬子，夜东北天鸣，如风水相搏者五七次。

translations.literal: Zhengde year 1, second month, day renzi, at night the northeast sky sounded like wind and water clashing five or seven times.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengde 1, second month, renzi: at night the northeast sky sounded like wind and water clashing five or seven times.

sentences.zh: 隆庆二年八月甲辰，绛州西北天裂，自丑至寅乃合。

translations.literal: Longqing year 2, eighth month, day jiachen, northwest of Jiang Prefecture the sky split open; from chou to yin it closed again.
translations.idiomatic: Longqing 2, eighth month, jiachen: northwest of Jiang Prefecture the sky split open; from chou to yin it closed again.

sentences.zh: 万历十六年九月乙丑，甘肃石灰沟天鸣，云中如犬状乱吠，有声。

translations.literal: Wanli year 16, ninth month, day yichou, at Shihuigou in Gansu the sky sounded; in the clouds shapes like dogs barked wildly, with sound.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 16, ninth month, yichou: at Shihuigou in Gansu the sky sounded; in the clouds shapes like dogs barked wildly, with audible sound.

sentences.zh: 崇祯元年三月辛巳，昧爽，天赤如血，射窗牖皆红。

translations.literal: Chongzhen year 1, third month, day xinsi, before dawn the sky was red like blood, and light through the windows was all red.
translations.idiomatic: Chongzhen 1, third month, xinsi: before dawn the sky was red like blood, and light through the windows was all red.

sentences.zh: 十年九月，每晨夕天色赤黄。

translations.literal: Year 10, ninth month, every morning and evening the colour of the sky was red-yellow.
translations.idiomatic: Chongzhen 10, ninth month: every morning and evening the colour of the sky was red-yellow.

sentences.zh: ▲日变月变

translations.literal: ▲ Solar and lunar transformations.
translations.idiomatic: ▲ Solar and lunar transformations.

sentences.zh: 洪武二年十二月甲子，日中有黑子。

translations.literal: Hongwu year 2, twelfth month, day jiazi, there was a black spot in the sun.
translations.idiomatic: Hongwu 2, twelfth month, jiazi: there was a black spot on the sun.

sentences.zh: 三年九月戊戌，十月丁巳，十一月甲辰，四年三月戊戌，五月壬子至辛巳，九月戊寅，五年正月庚戌，二月丁未，五月甲子，七月辛未，六年十一月戊戌朔，七年二月庚戌至甲寅，八年二月辛亥，九月癸未，十二月癸丑，十四年二月壬午至乙酉，十五年闰二月丙戌，十二月辛巳，并如之。

translations.literal: Year 3, ninth month wuxu; tenth month dingsi; eleventh month jiachen; year 4, third month wuxu; fifth month, from renzi to xinsi; ninth month wuyin; year 5, first month gengxu; second month dingwei; fifth month jiazi; seventh month xinwei; year 6, eleventh month, new moon on wuxu; year 7, second month, from gengxu to jiayin; year 8, second month xinhai; ninth month guiwei; twelfth month guichou; year 14, second month, from renwu to yiyou; year 15, intercalary second month bingxu; twelfth month xinsi—all were like it.
translations.idiomatic: Hongwu 3/IX/wuxu; 3/X/dingsi; 3/XI/jiachen; 4/III/wuxu; 4/V/renzi–xinsi; 4/IX/wuyin; 5/I/gengxu; 5/II/dingwei; 5/V/jiazi; 5/VII/xinwei; 6/XI/wuxu (new moon); 7/II/gengxu–jiayin; 8/II/xinhai; 8/IX/guiwei; 8/XII/guichou; 14/II/renwu–yiyou; 15/intercalary II/bingxu; 15/XII/xinsi: on each date it was the same.

sentences.zh: 正统元年八月癸酉至己卯，月出入时皆有游气，色赤无光。

translations.literal: Zhengtong year 1, eighth month, from guiyou to jimao, whenever the moon rose or set there was wandering vapour, red in colour and without light.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengtong 1, eighth month, guiyou–jimao: whenever the moon rose or set there was wandering vapour, red in colour and without light.

sentences.zh: 十四年八月辛未，月昼见，与日争明。

translations.literal: Year 14, eighth month, day xinwei, the moon was seen by day and vied with the sun for brightness.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengtong 14, eighth month, xinwei: the moon was seen by day and vied with the sun for brightness.

sentences.zh: 十月壬申，日上黑气如烟，寻发红光，散焰如火。

translations.literal: Tenth month, day renshen, black vapour on the sun like smoke; soon it emitted red light and scattered flames like fire.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, renshen: black vapour on the sun like smoke; soon it emitted red light and scattered flames like fire.

sentences.zh: 景泰二年四月己卯，月色如赭。

translations.literal: Jingtai year 2, fourth month, day jimao, the colour of the moon was like ochre.
translations.idiomatic: Jingtai 2, fourth month, jimao: the colour of the moon was like ochre.

sentences.zh: 七年九月丙子，日色变赤。

translations.literal: Year 7, ninth month, day bingzi, the colour of the sun turned red.
translations.idiomatic: Jingtai 7, ninth month, bingzi: the colour of the sun turned red.

sentences.zh: 天顺二年闰二月己巳，日无光，旋赤如赭。

translations.literal: Tianshun year 2, intercalary second month, day jisi, the sun had no light; presently it turned red like ochre.
translations.idiomatic: Tianshun 2, intercalary second month, jisi: the sun had no light; presently it turned red like ochre.

sentences.zh: 三年八月丁卯，日色如赭。

translations.literal: Year 3, eighth month, day dingmao, the colour of the sun was like ochre.
translations.idiomatic: Tianshun 3, eighth month, dingmao: the colour of the sun was like ochre.

sentences.zh: 六年十月丙子，日赤如血。

translations.literal: Year 6, tenth month, day bingzi, the sun was red like blood.
translations.idiomatic: Tianshun 6, tenth month, bingzi: the sun was red like blood.

sentences.zh: 七年四月癸未，如之。

translations.literal: Year 7, fourth month, day guimao, it was like it.
translations.idiomatic: Tianshun 7, fourth month, guimao: it was the same.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，日色变白。

translations.literal: On yiyou the colour of the sun turned white.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou the colour of the sun turned white.

sentences.zh: 八年二月己亥，日无光。

translations.literal: Year 8, second month, day jihai, the sun had no light.
translations.idiomatic: Tianshun 8, second month, jihai: the sun had no light.

sentences.zh: 成化五年闰二月己卯，日色变白。

translations.literal: Chenghua year 5, intercalary second month, day jimao, the colour of the sun turned white.
translations.idiomatic: Chenghua 5, intercalary second month, jimao: the colour of the sun turned white.

sentences.zh: 十一年二月己亥，日色如赭。

translations.literal: Year 11, second month, day jihai, the colour of the sun was like ochre.
translations.idiomatic: Chenghua 11, second month, jihai: the colour of the sun was like ochre.

sentences.zh: 四月辛卯，如之。

translations.literal: Fourth month, day xinmao, it was like it.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, xinmao: it was the same.

sentences.zh: 十三年三月壬申，日白无光。

translations.literal: Year 13, third month, day renshen, the sun was white and without light.
translations.idiomatic: Chenghua 13, third month, renshen: the sun was white and without light.

sentences.zh: 十月辛卯，十四年三月庚午，十六年三月丙戌，并如之。

translations.literal: Tenth month, day xinmao; year 14, third month, day gengwu; year 16, third month, day bingxu—all were like it.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, xinmao; Chenghua 14/III/gengwu; 16/III/bingxu: on each date it was the same.

sentences.zh: 十七年三月丁酉，日赤如赭。

translations.literal: Year 17, third month, day dingyou, the sun was red like ochre.
translations.idiomatic: Chenghua 17, third month, dingyou: the sun was red like ochre.

sentences.zh: 十八年四月壬寅，日赤无光。

translations.literal: Year 18, fourth month, day renyin, the sun was red and without light.
translations.idiomatic: Chenghua 18, fourth month, renyin: the sun was red and without light.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸酉，日赤如赭。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day guiyou, the sun was red like ochre.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, guiyou: the sun was red like ochre.

sentences.zh: 二十年二月癸酉，如之。

translations.literal: Year 20, second month, day guiyou, it was like it.
translations.idiomatic: Chenghua 20, second month, guiyou: it was the same.

sentences.zh: 弘治元年十一月己卯，月生芒如齿，长三尺余，色苍白。

translations.literal: Hongzhi year 1, eleventh month, day jimao, the moon grew rays like teeth, more than three chi long, pale white in colour.
translations.idiomatic: Hongzhi 1, eleventh month, jimao: the moon grew rays like teeth, more than three chi long and pale white in colour.

sentences.zh: 十八年八月癸酉至九月甲午，日无光。

translations.literal: Year 18, eighth month, from guiyou to ninth month jiawu, the sun had no light.
translations.idiomatic: Hongzhi 18, eighth month, guiyou, through ninth month, jiawu: the sun had no light.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖元年正月丁卯，日惨白，变青，无光。

translations.literal: Jiajing year 1, first month, day dingmao, the sun was ghastly white, turned greenish, and had no light.
translations.idiomatic: Jiajing 1, first month, dingmao: the sun was ghastly white, turned greenish, and had no light.

sentences.zh: 二十八年三月丙申至庚子，日色惨白。

translations.literal: Year 28, third month, from bingchen to gengzi, the colour of the sun was ghastly white.
translations.idiomatic: Jiajing 28, third month, bingchen–gengzi: the colour of the sun was ghastly white.

sentences.zh: 三十四年十二月庚申，晦，日忽暗，有青黑紫日影如盘数十相摩，久之千百，飞荡满天，向西北而散。

translations.literal: Year 34, twelfth month, day gengshen, on the last day of the month the sun suddenly darkened; green, black, and purple solar shadows like disks, several dozen rubbing together; after a long while there were thousands, flying and filling the sky, scattering toward the northwest.
translations.idiomatic: Jiajing 34, twelfth month, gengshen: on the last day of the month the sun suddenly darkened; green, black, and purple solar shadows like disks, several dozen rubbing together; after a long while there were thousands, flying and filling the sky, scattering toward the northwest.

sentences.zh: 万历二十五年三月癸丑，黑日二三十余，回绕日旁，移时云隐不见。

translations.literal: Wanli year 25, third month, day guichou, black suns twenty or thirty circled beside the sun; after a time clouds hid them and they were not seen.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 25, third month, guichou: twenty or thirty black suns circled beside the sun; after a time clouds hid them from view.

sentences.zh: 五月辛卯朔，日光转荡，旋为黑饼。

translations.literal: Fifth month, new moon on xinmao, the sunlight whirled and turned into a black cake.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, new moon on xinmao: the sunlight whirled and turned into a black disk.

sentences.zh: 三十年三月甲申，日光照地黄赤。

translations.literal: Year 30, third month, day jiashen, the sunlight shone on the ground yellow-red.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 30, third month, jiashen: the sunlight shone on the ground yellow-red.

sentences.zh: 三十五年十一月丙午，日赤无光，烛地如血。

translations.literal: Year 35, eleventh month, day bingwu, the sun was red and without light, lighting the ground like blood.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 35, eleventh month, bingwu: the sun was red and without light, lighting the ground like blood.

sentences.zh: 四十二年三月庚辰，日赤黄如赭如血者累日。

translations.literal: Year 42, third month, day gengchen, for many days the sun was red-yellow like ochre and like blood.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 42, third month, gengchen: for many days the sun was red-yellow like ochre and like blood.

sentences.zh: 四十四年八月戊辰，日中有黑光。

translations.literal: Year 44, eighth month, day wuchen, there was black light in the sun.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 44, eighth month, wuchen: there was black light in the sun.

sentences.zh: 四十六年闰六月丙戌至戊子，黑气出入日中摩荡。

translations.literal: Year 46, intercalary sixth month, from bingxu to wuzi, black vapour went in and out of the sun, rubbing and churning.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 46, intercalary sixth month, bingxu–wuzi: black vapour went in and out of the sun, rubbing and churning.

sentences.zh: 天启四年正月癸未，日赤无光，有黑子二三荡于旁，渐至百许，凡四日。

translations.literal: Tianqi year 4, first month, day guimao, the sun was red and without light; two or three black spots oscillated beside it, gradually reaching about a hundred; altogether four days.
translations.idiomatic: Tianqi 4, first month, guimao: the sun was red and without light; two or three black spots oscillated beside it, gradually reaching about a hundred; altogether four days.

sentences.zh: 二月壬子，日淡黄无光。

translations.literal: Second month, day renzi, the sun was pale yellow and without light.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, renzi: the sun was pale yellow and without light.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，黑日摩荡日旁。

translations.literal: On guichou black suns rubbed and churned beside the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou black suns rubbed and churned beside the sun.

sentences.zh: 四月癸酉，日中黑气摩荡。

translations.literal: Fourth month, day guiyou, black vapour in the sun rubbed and churned.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, guiyou: black vapour in the sun rubbed and churned.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛巳，午刻，非烟非雾，覆压日上，摩荡如盖如吞，通天皆赤。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day xinsi, at the noon watch, neither smoke nor mist covered and pressed upon the sun, rubbing like a cover and like swallowing; all heaven turned red.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, xinsi: at the noon watch, neither smoke nor mist covered and pressed upon the sun, rubbing like a cover and like swallowing; all heaven turned red.

sentences.zh: 崇祯四年正月戊戌，日色如血，照人物皆赤。

translations.literal: Chongzhen year 4, first month, day wuxu, the colour of the sun was like blood, illuminating people and things all red.
translations.idiomatic: Chongzhen 4, first month, wuxu: the colour of the sun was like blood, illuminating people and things all red.

sentences.zh: 二月乙巳朔，日赤如血，无光。

translations.literal: Second month, new moon on yisi, the sun was red like blood and without light.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, new moon on yisi: the sun was red like blood and without light.

sentences.zh: 十月丙午，月昼见。

translations.literal: Tenth month, day bingwu, the moon was seen by day.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, bingwu: the moon was seen by day.

sentences.zh: 十一年十一月癸亥，日中有黑子及黑青白气。

translations.literal: Year 11, eleventh month, day guihai, in the sun there were black spots and black, green, and white vapour.
translations.idiomatic: Chongzhen 11, eleventh month, guihai: in the sun there were black spots and black, green, and white vapour.

sentences.zh: 日入时，日光摩荡如两日。

translations.literal: At sunset the sunlight rubbed and churned like two suns.
translations.idiomatic: At sunset the sunlight rubbed and churned like two suns.

sentences.zh: 十二年正月己未朔，日白无光。

translations.literal: Year 12, first month, new moon on jiwei, the sun was white and without light.
translations.idiomatic: Chongzhen 12, first month, new moon on jiwei: the sun was white and without light.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，日光摩荡竟日，有气从日中出，如镜黛喷花。

translations.literal: On xinyou the sunlight rubbed and churned all day; vapour issued from the sun like ink from a mirror spraying flowers.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou the sunlight rubbed and churned all day; vapour issued from the sun like ink from a mirror spraying flowers.

sentences.zh: 二月庚子，日旁有红白丸，又白芒黑气交掩，日光摩荡。

translations.literal: Second month, day gengzi, beside the sun there were red and white pellets, and white rays and black vapour crossed and masked one another; the sunlight rubbed and churned.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, gengzi: beside the sun there were red and white pellets, and white rays and black vapour crossed and masked one another; the sunlight rubbed and churned.

sentences.zh: 十三年九月己巳，两日并出，辰刻乃合为一，入时又分为二。

translations.literal: Year 13, ninth month, day jisi, two suns appeared together; at the chen watch they merged into one; at set they again divided into two.
translations.idiomatic: Chongzhen 13, ninth month, jisi: two suns appeared together; at the chen watch they merged into one; at sunset they again divided into two.

sentences.zh: 十四年正月壬寅，日青无光。

translations.literal: Year 14, first month, day renyin, the sun was greenish and without light.
translations.idiomatic: Chongzhen 14, first month, renyin: the sun was greenish and without light.

sentences.zh: 后三年正月癸丑，有星入月。

translations.literal: Three years afterward, first month, day guichou, a star entered the moon.
translations.idiomatic: Three years afterward, first month, guichou: a star entered the moon.

sentences.zh: 三月壬寅，日色无光者两旬。

translations.literal: Third month, day renyin, the sun had no light for two weeks.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, renyin: the sun had no light for two weeks.

sentences.zh: ▲晕适

translations.literal: ▲ Halos and related phenomena.
translations.idiomatic: ▲ Halos and related phenomena.

sentences.zh: 洪武六年三月戊辰，日交晕。

translations.literal: Hongwu year 6, third month, day wuchen, intersecting halos on the sun.
translations.idiomatic: Hongwu 6, third month, wuchen: intersecting halos on the sun.

sentences.zh: 十年正月己巳，白虹贯日。

translations.literal: Year 10, first month, day jisi, a white rainbow pierced the sun.
translations.idiomatic: Hongwu 10, first month, jisi: a white rainbow pierced the sun.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲子，白虹贯月。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day jiazi, a white rainbow pierced the moon.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, jiazi: a white rainbow pierced the moon.

sentences.zh: 十二年四月庚申，日交晕。

translations.literal: Twelfth year, fourth month, day gengshen, the sun showed crossing halos.
translations.idiomatic: Hongwu 12, fourth month, gengshen: the sun showed crossing halos.

sentences.zh: 二四年正月壬子，日有珥，白虹贯之。

translations.literal: Twenty-fourth year, first month, day renzi, the sun had parhelia; a white arc crossed them.
translations.idiomatic: Hongwu 24, first month, renzi: the sun had parhelia, and a white arc crossed them.

sentences.zh: 九月甲辰，白虹贯日。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day jiachen, a white arc crossed the sun.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, jiachen: a white arc crossed the sun.

sentences.zh: 十五年正月丁未，十九年三月己巳，二十二年十二月戊午，并如之。

translations.literal: Fifteenth year, first month, day dingwei; nineteenth year, third month, day jisi; twenty-second year, twelfth month, day wuwu—all the same.
translations.idiomatic: Fifteenth year, dingwei; nineteenth year, third month, jisi; twenty-second year, twelfth month, wuwu: all the same.

sentences.zh: 二十三年正月壬辰，日晕，白虹贯珥。

translations.literal: Twenty-third year, first month, day renchen, solar halo; white arc crossed the parhelia.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty-third year, first month, renchen: a solar halo; a white arc crossed the parhelia.

sentences.zh: 二十八年十一月乙亥，日上赤气长五丈余，须臾又生直气、背气，皆青赤色。

translations.literal: Twenty-eighth year, eleventh month, day yihai, red qi on the sun more than five zhang long; presently upright qi and back aura also arose, all blue-red.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty-eighth year, eleventh month, yihai: red vapor on the sun stretched more than five zhang; presently upright vapor and a back aura also appeared, all blue-red.

sentences.zh: 又生半晕，两白虹贯珥，已而弥天贯日。

translations.literal: Again a semicircular halo arose; two white arcs crossed the parhelia; then filling heaven crossed the sun.
translations.idiomatic: A semicircular halo followed; two white arcs crossed the parhelia, then spanned the sky and crossed the sun.

sentences.zh: 三十年二月辛亥，白虹亘天贯日。

translations.literal: Thirtieth year, second month, day xinhai, white arc spanning heaven crossed the sun.
translations.idiomatic: Thirtieth year, second month, xinhai: a white arc spanning heaven crossed the sun.

sentences.zh: 永乐十八年闰正月癸未，日生重半晕，上有青赤背气，左右有珥，白虹贯之，随生黄气、璚气。

translations.literal: Yongle year 18, intercalary first month, day guimao, the sun produced a double semicircular halo; above were blue-red back aura; left and right had parhelia; white arc crossed them; following arose yellow qi and jade aura.
translations.idiomatic: Yongle 18, intercalary first month, guimao: the sun showed a double semicircular halo with blue-red back aura above, parhelia left and right, and a white arc crossing them; yellow vapor and jade aura followed.

sentences.zh: 洪熙元年正月乙未，日生两珥，白虹贯之。

translations.literal: Hongxi year 1, first month, day yiwei, the sun produced two parhelia; white arc crossed them.
translations.idiomatic: Hongxi 1, first month, yiwei: the sun produced two parhelia, and a white arc crossed them.

sentences.zh: 四月丁未，如之，复生交晕。

translations.literal: Fourth month, day dingwei, the same; again crossing halos arose.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, dingwei: the same; crossing halos appeared again.

sentences.zh: 宣德元年正月庚戌，日生青赤璚气，随生交晕，色黄赤。

translations.literal: Xuande year 1, first month, day gengxu, the sun produced blue-red jade aura; following arose crossing halos, color yellow-red.
translations.idiomatic: Xuande 1, first month, gengxu: the sun showed blue-red jade aura, then crossing halos in yellow-red.

sentences.zh: 二月己卯，日两珥，又生交晕，左右有珥，上重半晕及背气。

translations.literal: Second month, day jimao, the sun had two parhelia; again crossing halos arose; left and right had parhelia; above a double semicircular halo and back aura.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, jimao: two parhelia on the sun, then crossing halos with parhelia left and right, a double semicircular halo above, and a back aura.

sentences.zh: 昏刻，月生两珥，白虹贯之。

translations.literal: Dusk watch, the moon produced two parhelia; white arc crossed them.
translations.idiomatic: At dusk watch the moon showed two parhelia, and a white arc crossed them.

sentences.zh: 二年十二月甲戌，月生交晕，左右珥，白虹贯之。

translations.literal: Second year, twelfth month, day jiaxu, the moon produced crossing halos; left and right parhelia; white arc crossed them.
translations.idiomatic: Xuande 2, twelfth month, jiaxu: the moon showed crossing halos with parhelia left and right, and a white arc crossing them.

sentences.zh: 三年三月庚寅，日生交晕，色黄赤，两珥及背气、戟气各一，色皆青赤。

translations.literal: Third year, third month, day gengyin, the sun produced crossing halos, color yellow-red; two parhelia and back aura and halberd aura each one, colors all blue-red.
translations.idiomatic: Third year, third month, gengyin: crossing halos on the sun in yellow-red, with two parhelia and one back aura and one halberd aura, all blue-red.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，日晕，又交晕及戟气二道。

translations.literal: Day dingyou, solar halo; again crossing halos and two halberd auras.
translations.idiomatic: Dingyou: a solar halo, then crossing halos and two halberd auras.

sentences.zh: 十二月己卯，日生交晕。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day jimao, the sun produced crossing halos.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, jimao: the sun showed crossing halos.

sentences.zh: 五年正月癸亥，日晕，随生交晕。

translations.literal: Fifth year, first month, day guihai, solar halo; following arose crossing halos.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth year, first month, guihai: a solar halo, then crossing halos.

sentences.zh: 二月甲午，日交晕，随生戟气。

translations.literal: Second month, day jiawu, the sun showed crossing halos; following arose halberd aura.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, jiawu: crossing halos on the sun, then a halberd aura.

sentences.zh: 四月庚辰，日生两珥，白虹贯之。

translations.literal: Fourth month, day gengchen, the sun produced two parhelia; white arc crossed them.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, gengchen: the sun produced two parhelia, and a white arc crossed them.

sentences.zh: 六年二月甲寅，日晕，随生交晕及重半晕璚气。

translations.literal: Sixth year, second month, day jiayin, solar halo; following arose crossing halos and double semicircular halo jade aura.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth year, second month, jiayin: a solar halo, then crossing halos and a double semicircular halo with jade aura.

sentences.zh: 八年九月戊戌，辰刻，日晕，两珥背气，申刻诸气复生。

translations.literal: Eighth year, ninth month, day wuxu, chen watch, solar halo, two parhelia and back aura; shen watch all qi again arose.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth year, ninth month, wuxu: at chen watch a solar halo with two parhelia and a back aura; at shen watch all the phenomena returned.

sentences.zh: 十年十二月辛亥，日晕，白虹贯两珥，有璚气，随生重半晕及背气。

translations.literal: Tenth year, twelfth month, day xinhai, solar halo; white arc crossed the two parhelia; there was jade aura; following arose double semicircular halo and back aura.
