translations.idiomatic: Tenth year, twelfth month, xinhai: a solar halo; a white arc crossed both parhelia; jade aura appeared, then a double semicircular halo and back aura.

sentences.zh: 正统元年二月己酉，白虹贯月。

translations.literal: Zhengtong year 1, second month, day jiyou, white arc crossed the moon.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengtong 1, second month, jiyou: a white arc crossed the moon.

sentences.zh: 九月丁未，如之。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day dingwei, the same.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, dingwei: the same.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙戌，月生背气，左右珥，白虹贯之。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day bingxu, the moon produced back aura; left and right parhelia; white arc crossed them.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, bingxu: the moon showed a back aura with parhelia left and right, and a white arc crossing them.

sentences.zh: 三年四月庚辰，日生两珥，白虹贯之，随晕。

translations.literal: Third year, fourth month, day gengchen, the sun produced two parhelia; white arc crossed them; following halo.
translations.idiomatic: Third year, fourth month, gengchen: the sun produced two parhelia with a white arc crossing them, then a halo.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸酉，月生两珥，白虹贯之，随生背气。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day guiyou, the moon produced two parhelia; white arc crossed them; following arose back aura.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, guiyou: the moon showed two parhelia with a white arc crossing them, then a back aura.

sentences.zh: 七年十二月辛丑，月晕，白虹贯之。

translations.literal: Seventh year, twelfth month, day xinchou, lunar halo; white arc crossed it.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh year, twelfth month, xinchou: a lunar halo with a white arc crossing it.

sentences.zh: 十一年正月乙未，日生背气，白虹弥天。

translations.literal: Eleventh year, first month, day yiwei, the sun produced back aura; white arc filled heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh year, first month, yiwei: the sun showed a back aura, and a white arc filled heaven.

sentences.zh: 十四年八月戊申，日晕，旁有戟气，随生左右珥及戴气，东北虹霓如杵。

translations.literal: Fourteenth year, eighth month, day wushen, solar halo; beside was halberd aura; following arose left and right parhelia and cap aura; northeast rainbow like a pestle.
translations.idiomatic: Fourteenth year, eighth month, wushen: a solar halo with a halberd aura beside it, then parhelia left and right and a cap aura; in the northeast a rainbow like a pestle.

sentences.zh: 景泰元年二月壬午，酉刻，日上黑气四道，约长三丈，离地丈许，两头锐而贯日，其状如鱼。

translations.literal: Jingtai year 1, second month, day renwu, you watch, on the sun four black qi, about three zhang long, one zhang from the ground, both ends sharp and piercing the sun, shape like fish.
translations.idiomatic: Jingtai 1, second month, renwu: at you watch four black vapors on the sun, about three zhang long and one zhang above the ground, pointed at both ends and piercing the disk, shaped like fish.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲午，日交晕，上下背气各一道，两旁戟气各一道。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day jiawu, the sun showed crossing halos; above and below back aura each one strip; both sides halberd aura each one strip.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, jiawu: crossing halos on the sun, one back aura above and below, and one halberd aura on each side.

sentences.zh: 二年正月癸卯，日生左右珥，白虹贯之，随生背气。

translations.literal: Second year, first month, day guimao, the sun produced left and right parhelia; white arc crossed them; following arose back aura.
translations.idiomatic: Second year, first month, guimao: the sun showed parhelia left and right with a white arc crossing them, then a back aura.

sentences.zh: 二月丙戌，日交晕。

translations.literal: Second month, day bingxu, the sun showed crossing halos.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, bingxu: the sun showed crossing halos.

sentences.zh: 三年正月丙辰，日生左右珥及背气、白虹。

translations.literal: Third year, first month, day bingchen, the sun produced left and right parhelia and back aura and white arc.
translations.idiomatic: Third year, first month, bingchen: the sun showed parhelia left and right with back aura and a white arc.

sentences.zh: 五年十一月壬戌，月晕，左右珥及背气，又生白虹，贯右珥。

translations.literal: Fifth year, eleventh month, day renxu, lunar halo; left and right parhelia and back aura; again white arc arose, crossing the right parhelion.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth year, eleventh month, renxu: a lunar halo with parhelia and back aura left and right; a white arc then crossed the right parhelion.

sentences.zh: 七年六月丁丑，日晕，随生重半晕及左右珥。

translations.literal: Seventh year, sixth month, day dingchou, solar halo; following arose double semicircular halo and left and right parhelia.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh year, sixth month, dingchou: a solar halo, then a double semicircular halo and parhelia left and right.

sentences.zh: 天顺元年二月庚戌，辰刻，日交晕，左右珥，旋生抱气及左右戟气，白虹贯日。

translations.literal: Tianshun year 1, second month, day gengxu, chen watch, the sun showed crossing halos; left and right parhelia; presently embracing aura and left and right halberd auras arose; white arc crossed the sun.
translations.idiomatic: Tianshun 1, second month, gengxu: at chen watch crossing halos on the sun with parhelia left and right; embracing aura and halberd auras left and right then appeared, and a white arc crossed the sun.

sentences.zh: 未刻，诸气复生。

translations.literal: Wei watch, all qi again arose.
translations.idiomatic: At wei watch all the phenomena returned.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，日交晕，左右珥及戟气，白虹贯日，弥天者竟日。

translations.literal: Day xinhai, the sun showed crossing halos; left and right parhelia and halberd aura; white arc crossed the sun; filling heaven lasted the whole day.
translations.idiomatic: Xinhai: crossing halos on the sun with parhelia and halberd aura left and right; a white arc crossed the sun and filled heaven for the whole day.

sentences.zh: 二年二月乙卯，日交晕，上有背气，白虹贯日。

translations.literal: Second year, second month, day yimao, the sun showed crossing halos; above was back aura; white arc crossed the sun.
translations.idiomatic: Second year, second month, yimao: crossing halos on the sun with a back aura above, and a white arc crossing the sun.

sentences.zh: 七年正月戊戌，月生连环晕。

translations.literal: Seventh year, first month, day wuxu, the moon produced interlocking halos.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh year, first month, wuxu: the moon showed interlocking halos.

sentences.zh: 成化二年四月壬寅，日交晕，右有珥。

translations.literal: Chenghua year 2, fourth month, day renyin, the sun showed crossing halos; on the right was a parhelion.
translations.idiomatic: Chenghua 2, fourth month, renyin: crossing halos on the sun with a parhelion on the right.

sentences.zh: 十一年六月己酉，日重晕，左右珥及背气。

translations.literal: Eleventh year, sixth month, day jiyou, the sun had double halos; left and right parhelia and back aura.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh year, sixth month, jiyou: double halos on the sun with parhelia and a back aura left and right.

sentences.zh: 十二年正月甲子，日交晕。

translations.literal: Twelfth year, first month, day jiazi, the sun showed crossing halos.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth year, first month, jiazi: the sun showed crossing halos.

sentences.zh: 二十年二月己未，日生白虹，东北亘天。

translations.literal: Twentieth year, second month, day jiwei, the sun produced white arc; northeast spanning heaven.

sentences.zh: 二十年五月丙申，有大星坠番禺县东南，声如雷，散为小星十余。

translations.literal: Twentieth year, fifth month, day bingshen, a large star fell southeast of Panyu County, sound like thunder, scattering into more than ten small stars.
translations.idiomatic: Twentieth year, fifth month, bingshen: a large star fell southeast of Panyu County with a thunderous sound and broke into more than ten small stars.

sentences.zh: 既而天地皆晦，良久乃复。

translations.literal: Presently heaven and earth both grew dark; long afterward they recovered.
translations.idiomatic: Presently heaven and earth both darkened; only after a long while did light return.

sentences.zh: 二十一年正月甲申朔，申刻，有火光自中天少西下坠，化白气，复曲折上腾有声。

translations.literal: Twenty-first year, first month, day jiashen new moon, shen watch, there was fire-light from slightly west of mid-heaven falling, transforming to white vapor, again winding upward with sound.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty-first year, first month, new moon on jiashen, at the shen watch (3–5 p.m.): fire-light fell from slightly west of mid-heaven, turned to white vapor, then curved upward again with a sound.

sentences.zh: 逾时，西方有赤星大如碗，自中天西行近浊，尾迹化白气，曲曲如蛇行良久，正西轰轰如雷震。

translations.literal: After a time, in the west there was a red star large as a bowl, from mid-heaven moving west near the Turbid, trail transforming to white vapor winding like a serpent for a long while; due west rumbled like thunder.
translations.idiomatic: After a time a red star large as a bowl moved from mid-heaven west toward the Turbid, its trail turning to white vapor that wound like a serpent for a long while; due west thundered like an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 弘治元年八月戊申，巳刻，南方流星如盏，自南行丈余，大如碗，西南至近浊，尾化白云，屈曲蛇行而散。

translations.literal: Hongzhi year 1, eighth month, day wushen, si watch, southern meteor like a lamp-cup, from south moving more than a zhang, large as a bowl, southwest to near the Turbid, tail transforming to white cloud, winding serpent-like and dispersing.
translations.idiomatic: Hongzhi 1, eighth month, wushen, si watch (9–11 a.m.): a southern meteor like a lamp-cup moved from the south more than a zhang, swelled to bowl size, went southwest to near the Turbid, and its tail turned white cloud that wound like a serpent and dispersed.

sentences.zh: 四年十月丁巳，有星赤，光如电，自西南往东北，声如鼓。

translations.literal: Fourth year, tenth month, day dingsi, there was a star red, light like lightning, from southwest toward northeast, sound like drum.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth year, tenth month, dingsi: a red star with lightning-like light passed from southwest to northeast with a drum-like sound.

sentences.zh: 陨光山县，化为石如斗。

translations.literal: It fell in Guangshan County, transforming to stone like a dipper.
translations.idiomatic: It fell in Guangshan County and became stone the size of a dipper.

sentences.zh: 光州商城亦见大星飞空，如光山所见。

translations.literal: Guang Prefecture Shangcheng also saw a large star flying in the sky, like what Guangshan saw.
translations.idiomatic: Shangcheng in Guang Prefecture also saw a large star fly through the sky, as at Guangshan.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲戌，星陨真定西北，红光烛天。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day jiaxu, a star fell northwest of Zhending, red light illuminating heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, jiaxu: a star fell northwest of Zhending, red light lighting heaven.

sentences.zh: 西南天鸣如鼓，又若奔车。

translations.literal: Southwest heaven sounded like drum, again like rushing chariot.
translations.idiomatic: The southwest sky sounded like drums, then again like rushing chariots.

sentences.zh: 七年五月，宣府、山西、河南有星昼陨。

translations.literal: Seventh year, fifth month, Xuanfu, Shanxi, and Henan had stars falling in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh year, fifth month: stars fell by day in Xuanfu, Shanxi, and Henan.

sentences.zh: 八年四月辛未，有星如轮，流至西北，陨于铅山县，其声如雷。

translations.literal: Eighth year, fourth month, day xinwei, there was a star like a wheel, streaming to the northwest, falling at Qianshan County, its sound like thunder.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth year, fourth month, xinwei: a star like a wheel streamed northwest and fell at Qianshan County with a thunderous sound.

sentences.zh: 九年闰三月戊午，平凉东南有流星如月，红光烛地，至西北止，既而天鼓鸣。

translations.literal: Ninth year, intercalary third month, day wuwu, southeast of Pingliang there was a meteor like the moon, red light illuminating the ground, reaching the northwest and stopping; presently the celestial drum sounded.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth year, intercalary third month, wuwu: southeast of Pingliang a meteor like the moon, red light illuminating the ground, reached the northwest and halted; then the celestial drum sounded.

sentences.zh: 十年正月壬子，有星大如斗，色黄白，光长三十余丈，一小星随之，陨于宁夏西北隅。

translations.literal: Tenth year, first month, day renzi, there was a star large as a dipper, color yellow-white, light more than thirty zhang long, one small star following, falling at the northwest corner of Ningxia.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth year, first month, renzi: a star large as a dipper, yellow-white in color, with light more than thirty zhang long and one small star following, fell at the northwest corner of Ningxia.

sentences.zh: 天鸣如雷者数声。

translations.literal: Heaven sounded like thunder several times.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven thundered several times.

sentences.zh: 九月乙巳，有星如斗，光掩月，流自西北，陨于永平，有声。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day yisi, there was a star like a dipper, light masking the moon, streaming from the northwest, falling at Yongping, with sound.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, yisi: a star like a dipper, its light eclipsing the moon, streamed from the northwest and fell at Yongping with a sound.

sentences.zh: 十一年正月癸亥，有流星陨于肃州，大如房，响如雷，良久灭。

translations.literal: Eleventh year, first month, day guihai, a meteor fell at Suzhou, large as a room, resounding like thunder, long afterward extinguished.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh year, first month, guihai: a meteor fell at Suzhou, large as a room, thundering as it went, and only after a long while faded.

sentences.zh: 十月壬申，晓，东方赤星如碗，行丈余，光烛地，东南行，小星数十随之。

translations.literal: Tenth month, day renshen, at dawn, eastern red star like a bowl, moving more than a zhang, light illuminating the ground, moving southeast, several tens of small stars following.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, renshen: at dawn an eastern red star like a bowl moved more than a zhang, its light illuminating the ground as it traveled southeast, with several tens of small stars following.

sentences.zh: 十四年闰七月辛巳，山东有星大如车轮，赤光烛天，自东南往西北，陨于寿光。

translations.literal: Fourteenth year, intercalary seventh month, day xinsi, Shandong had a star large as a carriage wheel, red light illuminating heaven, from southeast toward northwest, falling at Shouguang.
translations.idiomatic: Fourteenth year, intercalary seventh month, xinsi: in Shandong a star large as a carriage wheel, red light lighting heaven, passed from southeast to northwest and fell at Shouguang.

sentences.zh: 天鼓鸣。

translations.literal: The celestial drum sounded.
translations.idiomatic: The celestial drum sounded.

sentences.zh: 十六年正月己酉，南京有星昼流。

translations.literal: Sixteenth year, first month, day jiyou, Nanjing had a star streaming in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: Sixteenth year, first month, jiyou: a star streamed by day over Nanjing.

sentences.zh: 正德元年十二月庚午，有星如碗，陨宁夏中卫，空中有红光大二亩。

translations.literal: Zhengde year 1, twelfth month, day gengwu, there was a star like a bowl falling at Ningxia Zhongwei, in the sky red light large as two mu.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengde 1, twelfth month, gengwu: a star like a bowl fell at Zhongwei in Ningxia; in the sky red light spread over two mu.

sentences.zh: 二年八月己亥，宁夏有大星，自正南流西南而坠，后有赤光一道，阔三尺，长五丈。

translations.literal: Second year, eighth month, day jihai, Ningxia had a large star, from due south streaming southwest and falling, afterward a red light one track three chi wide and five zhang long.
translations.idiomatic: Second year, eighth month, jihai: in Ningxia a large star streamed from due south southwestward and fell; afterward a red streak three chi wide and five zhang long.

sentences.zh: 五年四月丁亥，雷州有大星如月，自东南流西北，分为二，尾如彗，随没，声如雷。

translations.literal: Fifth year, fourth month, day dinghai, Leizhou had a large star like the moon, from southeast streaming northwest, dividing into two, tail like a comet, following and vanishing, sound like thunder.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth year, fourth month, dinghai: in Leizhou a large star like the moon streamed from southeast to northwest, split in two with a comet-like tail, then vanished with a thunderous sound.

sentences.zh: 六年八月癸卯，有流星如箕，尾长四五丈，红光烛天。

translations.literal: Sixth year, eighth month, day guimao, there was a meteor like a winnowing-basket, tail four or five zhang long, red light illuminating heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth year, eighth month, guimao: a meteor like a winnowing-basket with a tail four or five zhang long, red light lighting heaven.

sentences.zh: 自西北转东南，三首一尾，坠四川崇庆卫。

translations.literal: From northwest turning southeast, three heads one tail, falling at Chongqing Guard in Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: It turned from northwest to southeast—three heads and one tail—and fell at Chongqing Guard in Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 色化为白，复起绿焰，高二丈余，声如雷震。

translations.literal: Color transformed to white, again rising green flame, more than two zhang high, sound like thunderclap.
translations.idiomatic: Its color turned white, then green flame rose more than two zhang high with a sound like thunder.

sentences.zh: 十五年正月丁未，酉刻，有星陨于山西龙舟谷巡检司厅事，四月丙戌，陕西巩昌府有星如日，色赤，自东方流西南而陨。

translations.literal: Fifteenth year, first month, day dingwei, you watch, a star fell at the hall of Longzhou Valley Inspection Office in Shanxi; fourth month, day bingxu, Gongchang Prefecture in Shaanxi had a star like the sun, color red, from east streaming southwest and falling.
translations.idiomatic: Fifteenth year, first month, dingwei, you watch (5–7 p.m.): a star fell on the hall of the Longzhou Valley inspection office in Shanxi; fourth month, bingxu: in Gongchang Prefecture, Shaanxi, a sun-like star, red in color, streamed from the east southwestward and fell.

sentences.zh: 天鼓鸣。

translations.literal: The celestial drum sounded.
translations.idiomatic: The celestial drum sounded.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖十二年九月丙子，流星如盏，光照地，自中台东北行近浊，尾迹化为白气。

translations.literal: Jiajing year 12, ninth month, day bingzi, meteor like a lamp-cup, light illuminating the ground, from Central Terrace moving northeast near the Turbid, trail transforming to white vapor.
translations.idiomatic: Jiajing 12, ninth month, bingzi: a meteor like a lamp-cup, its light illuminating the ground, moved from Central Terrace northeast toward the Turbid, its trail turning to white vapor.

sentences.zh: 四更至五更，四方大小流星，纵横交行，不计其数，至明乃息。

translations.literal: Fourth watch to fifth watch, on four sides large and small meteors crisscrossing, numberless, until dawn then ceasing.
translations.idiomatic: From the fourth to the fifth watch meteors large and small crisscrossed on every side beyond count, ceasing only at dawn.

sentences.zh: 十四年九月戊子，开封白昼天鼓鸣。

translations.literal: Fourteenth year, ninth month, day wuzi, Kaifeng in daytime the celestial drum sounded.
translations.idiomatic: Fourteenth year, ninth month, wuzi: at Kaifeng the celestial drum sounded in broad daylight.

sentences.zh: 有星如碗，东南流，众小星从之如珠。

translations.literal: There was a star like a bowl, moving southeast, many small stars following like pearls.
translations.idiomatic: A star like a bowl moved southeast, many small stars following like pearls.

sentences.zh: 十九年五月辛丑，星陨枣强，为石四。

translations.literal: Nineteenth year, fifth month, day xinchou, star fell at Zaoqiang, becoming four stones.
translations.idiomatic: Nineteenth year, fifth month, xinchou: a star fell at Zaoqiang and became four stones.

sentences.zh: 万历三年五月癸亥，昼，景州天鼓鸣。

translations.literal: Wanli year 3, fifth month, day guihai, daytime, Jing Prefecture celestial drum sounded.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 3, fifth month, guihai: in daytime at Jing Prefecture the celestial drum sounded.

sentences.zh: 陨星二，化为黑石。

translations.literal: Two falling stars, transforming to black stone.
translations.idiomatic: Two stars fell and became black stone.

sentences.zh: 四年十一月甲午，有四星陨费县，火光照地。

translations.literal: Fourth year, eleventh month, day jiawu, four stars fell at Fei County, fire-light illuminating the ground.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth year, eleventh month, jiawu: four stars fell at Fei County, fire-light illuminating the ground.

sentences.zh: 质明，落赤点于城西北，色如硃砂，长二里，阔一二尺。

translations.literal: At daybreak, a red mark fell northwest of the city, color like cinnabar, two li long, one or two chi wide.
translations.idiomatic: At daybreak a red mark fell northwest of the city, cinnabar in color, two li long and one or two chi wide.

sentences.zh: 是月，临漳有星长尺许，白昼北飞。

translations.literal: That month, Linzhang had a star more than a chi long flying north in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: That month at Linzhang a star more than a chi long flew north in daytime.

sentences.zh: 十三年七月辛巳，有星如碗，陨于沈丘莲花集。

translations.literal: Thirteenth year, seventh month, day xinsi, there was a star like a bowl falling at Lianhua Market in Shenqiu.
translations.idiomatic: Thirteenth year, seventh month, xinsi: a star like a bowl fell at Lianhua Market in Shenqiu.

sentences.zh: 天鼓鸣。

translations.literal: The celestial drum sounded.
translations.idiomatic: The celestial drum sounded.

sentences.zh: 十五年六月丙寅，平阳昼陨星。

translations.literal: Fifteenth year, sixth month, day bingyin, Pingyang had a star falling in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: Fifteenth year, sixth month, bingyin: a star fell by day at Pingyang.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，辰刻，有星如斗，陨于平阴，震响如雷。

translations.literal: Dingmao, chen watch, there was a star like a dipper falling at Pingyin, shock sound like thunder.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, at the chen watch (7–9 a.m.), a star like a dipper fell at Pingyin with a thunderous crash.

sentences.zh: 十七年正月庚申，有星陨西宁卫，大如月。

translations.literal: Seventeenth year, first month, day gengshen, a star fell at Xining Guard, large as the moon.
translations.idiomatic: Seventeenth year, first month, gengshen: a star fell at Xining Guard, large as the moon.

sentences.zh: 天鼓鸣。

translations.literal: The celestial drum sounded.
translations.idiomatic: The celestial drum sounded.

sentences.zh: 二十年二月丙辰，有三星陨闽县东南。

translations.literal: Twentieth year, second month, day bingchen, three stars fell southeast of Min County.
translations.idiomatic: Twentieth year, second month, bingchen: three stars fell southeast of Min County.

sentences.zh: 二十二年正月戊戌，保定青山口有大飞星，余光若彗，长二十余丈。

translations.literal: Twenty-second year, first month, day wuxu, at Qingshankou in Baoding there was a large flying star, remaining light like a comet, more than twenty zhang long.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty-second year, first month, wuxu: at Qingshankou in Baoding a large flying star left light like a comet more than twenty zhang long.

sentences.zh: 二十七年三月庚子，盖州卫天鼓鸣，连陨大星三。

translations.literal: Twenty-seventh year, third month, day gengzi, Gaizhou Guard celestial drum sounded, in succession three large stars fell.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty-seventh year, third month, gengzi: at Gaizhou Guard the celestial drum sounded and three large stars fell in succession.

sentences.zh: 三十年九月己未朔，有大星见东南，赤如血，大如碗，忽化为五，中星更明，久之会为一，大如簏。

translations.literal: Thirtieth year, ninth month, day jiwei new moon, a large star appeared in the southeast, red as blood, large as a bowl, suddenly transforming into five, the central star brighter still; after a long while joining into one, large as a basket.
translations.idiomatic: Thirtieth year, ninth month, new moon on jiwei: a large star appeared in the southeast, red as blood and large as a bowl, suddenly split into five with the central star brighter still; after a long while they merged into one large as a basket.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，有大小星数百交错行。

translations.literal: Xinsi, there were large and small stars several hundred crisscrossing.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, several hundred large and small stars crisscrossed.

sentences.zh: 十月壬辰，五更，流星起中天，光散七道，有声如雷。

translations.literal: Tenth month, day renchen, fifth watch, meteor rose at mid-heaven, light scattering in seven tracks, sound like thunder.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, renchen, fifth watch: a meteor rose at mid-heaven, its light scattering in seven tracks with a thunderous sound.

sentences.zh: 三十三年九月戊子，有星如碗，坠于南京龙江后营，光如火，至地游走如萤，移时灭。

translations.literal: Thirty-third year, ninth month, day wuzi, there was a star like a bowl falling at the rear camp of Longjiang in Nanjing, light like fire, reaching the ground wandering like fireflies, after a time extinguished.
translations.idiomatic: Thirty-third year, ninth month, wuzi: a star like a bowl fell at the Longjiang rear camp in Nanjing, light like fire; on the ground it wandered like fireflies and after a time went out.

sentences.zh: 明日，复有星如月，从西北流至阅兵台，分为三，坠地有声。

translations.literal: Next day, again a star like the moon, from northwest streaming to the military review platform, dividing into three, falling to earth with sound.
translations.idiomatic: The next day another star like the moon streamed from the northwest to the military review platform, split in three, and struck the ground with a sound.

sentences.zh: 十一月，有星陨南京教场，入地无迹。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, a star fell at Nanjing drill ground, entering earth without trace.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month: a star fell on the Nanjing drill ground and entered the earth without a trace.

sentences.zh: 三十五年十一月癸巳，有星陨于泾阳、淳化诸县，大如车轮，赤色，尾长丈余，声如轰雷。

translations.literal: Thirty-fifth year, eleventh month, day yisi, a star fell in Jingyang, Chunhua, and other counties, large as a carriage wheel, red in color, tail more than a zhang long, sound like rolling thunder.
translations.idiomatic: Thirty-fifth year, eleventh month, yisi: a star fell in Jingyang, Chunhua, and other counties, large as a carriage wheel, red, with a tail more than a zhang long and a sound like rolling thunder.

sentences.zh: 三十八年二月癸酉，有星大如斗，坠阳曲西北，碎星不绝。

translations.literal: Thirty-eighth year, second month, day guiyou, a star large as a dipper fell northwest of Yangqu, fragment stars unceasing.
translations.idiomatic: Thirty-eighth year, second month, guiyou: a star large as a dipper fell northwest of Yangqu, fragment stars raining without cease.

sentences.zh: 天鼓齐鸣。

translations.literal: Celestial drums all sounded together.
translations.idiomatic: The celestial drums all sounded together.

sentences.zh: 四十一年正月庚子，真定天鼓鸣。

translations.literal: Forty-first year, first month, day gengzi, Zhending celestial drum sounded.
translations.idiomatic: Forty-first year, first month, gengzi: at Zhending the celestial drum sounded.

sentences.zh: 流星昼陨有光。

translations.literal: Meteor fell in daytime with light.
translations.idiomatic: A meteor fell by day with a flash of light.

sentences.zh: 四十三年三月戊申，昼，星坠清丰东流邨，声如雷。

translations.literal: Forty-third year, third month, day wushen, daytime, star fell at Dongliu Village in Qingfeng, sound like thunder.
translations.idiomatic: Forty-third year, third month, wushen: in daytime a star fell at Dongliu Village in Qingfeng with a thunderous sound.

sentences.zh: 四十六年十月，辛酉，有星如斗，陨于南京安德门外，声如霹雳，化为石，重二十一斤。

translations.literal: Forty-sixth year, tenth month, xinyou, there was a star like a dipper falling outside Ande Gate in Nanjing, sound like thunderclap, transforming to stone weighing twenty-one jin.
translations.idiomatic: Forty-sixth year, tenth month, xinyou: a star like a dipper fell outside Ande Gate in Nanjing with a thunderclap, becoming stone weighing twenty-one jin.

sentences.zh: 天启三年九月甲寅，固原州星陨如雨。

translations.literal: Tianqi year 3, ninth month, day jiayin, Guyuan Circuit stars fell like rain.
translations.idiomatic: Tianqi 3, ninth month, jiayin: at Guyuan Circuit stars fell like rain.

sentences.zh: 崇祯十五年夏，星流如织。

translations.literal: Chongzhen year 15, summer, stars streaming like weaving.
translations.idiomatic: Chongzhen 15, summer: stars streamed thick as weaving.

sentences.zh: 后二年三月己丑朔，有星陨于御河。

translations.literal: Two years afterward, third month, day jichou new moon, a star fell in the Imperial Canal.
translations.idiomatic: Two years later, third month, new moon on jichou: a star fell in the Imperial Canal.

sentences.zh: ▲云气

translations.literal: ▲ Cloud vapor.
translations.idiomatic: ▲ Cloud vapor.

sentences.zh: 洪武四年四月辛丑，五色云见。

translations.literal: Hongwu year 4, fourth month, day xinchou, five-colored clouds appeared.
translations.idiomatic: Hongwu 4, fourth month, xinchou: five-colored clouds appeared.

sentences.zh: 戊申、乙酉，十一月壬戌，五年正月庚午、丙子，六月辛巳，七月己酉、壬子，八月己亥，六年六月丁丑，七月癸卯，七年四月丙午，五月丙戌、癸巳、甲午，六月乙未、乙卯，七月己卯，八月辛酉，八年正月壬申，四月丁未，五月庚午、癸未，六月壬辰、己亥，十月庚戌，九年八月癸巳，十四年九月甲申，十五年正月甲申，五月庚申，九月乙卯、丙寅，十一月辛酉，十八年四月癸巳、乙未，五月辛未、甲申，六月癸丑，十九年九月壬午，二十年十一月丁亥，五月乙酉，二十七年六月乙卯，并如之。

translations.literal: Wushen, yiyou, eleventh month renxu, fifth year first month gengwu, bingzi, sixth month xinsi, seventh month jiyou, renzi, eighth month jihai, sixth year sixth month dingchou, seventh month guimao, seventh year fourth month bingwu, fifth month bingxu, guisi, jiawu, sixth month yiwei, yimao, seventh month jimao, eighth month xinyou, eighth year first month renshen, fourth month dingwei, fifth month gengwu, guimao, sixth month renchen, jihai, tenth month gengxu, ninth year eighth month guisi, fourteenth year ninth month jiashen, fifteenth year first month jiashen, fifth month gengshen, ninth month yimao, bingyin, eleventh month xinyou, eighteenth year fourth month guisi, yiwei, fifth month xinwei, jiashen, sixth month guichou, nineteenth year ninth month renwu, twentieth year eleventh month dinghai, fifth month yiyou, twenty-seventh year sixth month yimao—all the same.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, yiyou, eleventh month renxu, fifth year first month gengwu and bingzi, sixth month xinsi, seventh month jiyou and renzi, eighth month jihai, sixth year sixth month dingchou and seventh month guimao, seventh year fourth month bingwu, fifth month bingxu, guisi, and jiawu, sixth month yiwei and yimao, seventh month jimao, eighth month xinyou, eighth year first month renshen, fourth month dingwei, fifth month gengwu and guimao, sixth month renchen and jihai, tenth month gengxu, ninth year eighth month guisi, fourteenth year ninth month jiashen, fifteenth year first month jiashen, fifth month gengshen, ninth month yimao and bingyin, eleventh month xinyou, eighteenth year fourth month guisi and yiwei, fifth month xinwei, jiashen, and sixth month guichou, nineteenth year ninth month renwu, twentieth year eleventh month dinghai and fifth month yiyou, and twenty-seventh year sixth month yimao: all the same.

sentences.zh: 永乐元年六月甲寅，日下五色云见。

translations.literal: Yongle year 1, sixth month, day jiayin, beneath the sun five-colored clouds appeared.
translations.idiomatic: Yongle 1, sixth month, jiayin: five-colored clouds appeared beneath the sun.

sentences.zh: 八月壬申，日珥随五色云见。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day renshen, solar ear-rings followed five-colored clouds appearing.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, renshen: solar parhelia appeared together with five-colored clouds.

sentences.zh: 八年二月庚戌，车驾次永安甸，日下五色云见。

translations.literal: Eighth year, second month, day gengxu, the imperial procession halted at Yong'an Marsh, beneath the sun five-colored clouds appeared.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth year, second month, gengxu: as the imperial procession halted at Yong'an Marsh, five-colored clouds appeared beneath the sun.

sentences.zh: 十一年六月戊申朔，武当山顶五色云见。

translations.literal: Eleventh year, sixth month, day wushen new moon, atop Wudang Mountain five-colored clouds appeared.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh year, sixth month, new moon on wushen: five-colored clouds appeared atop Wudang Mountain.

sentences.zh: 十七年九月丙辰、十二月癸未，庆云见。

translations.literal: Seventeenth year, ninth month, day bingchen, twelfth month, day guimao, auspicious clouds appeared.
translations.idiomatic: Seventeenth year, ninth month, bingchen, and twelfth month, guimao: auspicious clouds appeared.

sentences.zh: 二十二年十一月丙戌，月下五色云见。

translations.literal: Twenty-second year, eleventh month, day bingxu, beneath the moon five-colored clouds appeared.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty-second year, eleventh month, bingxu: five-colored clouds appeared beneath the moon.

sentences.zh: 洪熙元年二月癸酉、庚辰，三月乙未，俱五色云见。

translations.literal: Hongxi year 1, second month, days guiyou, gengchen, third month, day yiwei—all five-colored clouds appeared.
translations.idiomatic: Hongxi 1, second month, guiyou and gengchen, and third month, yiwei: on each day five-colored clouds appeared.

sentences.zh: 宣德元年八月庚辰，白云起东南，状如群羊惊走。

translations.literal: Xuande year 1, eighth month, day gengchen, white clouds rose in the southeast, shape like a flock of sheep startled into running.
translations.idiomatic: Xuande 1, eighth month, gengchen: white clouds rose in the southeast shaped like a flock of sheep fleeing in alarm.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙辰，北方有苍白云，东西竟天。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day bingchen, in the north there was pale white cloud spanning east and west across heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, bingchen: in the north pale white cloud stretched east and west across the sky.

sentences.zh: 二年十一月乙未，日下五色云见。

translations.literal: Second year, eleventh month, day yiwei, beneath the sun five-colored clouds appeared.
translations.idiomatic: Second year, eleventh month, yiwei: five-colored clouds appeared beneath the sun.

sentences.zh: 四年六月戊子，夜五色云见。

translations.literal: Fourth year, sixth month, day wuzi, at night five-colored clouds appeared.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth year, sixth month, wuzi: five-colored clouds appeared at night.

sentences.zh: 六年二月壬子，昏，西方有苍白云，南北竟天。

translations.literal: Sixth year, second month, day renzi, at dusk, in the west there was pale white cloud spanning north and south across heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth year, second month, renzi: at dusk pale white cloud in the west stretched north and south across the sky.

sentences.zh: 十年三月丁亥，月生五色云。

translations.literal: Tenth year, third month, day dinghai, the moon produced five-colored clouds.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth year, third month, dinghai: the moon produced five-colored clouds.

sentences.zh: 正统二年七月庚子，月生五色云。

translations.literal: Zhengtong year 2, seventh month, day gengzi, the moon had five-colored clouds.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengtong 2, seventh month, gengzi: five-colored clouds ringed the moon.

sentences.zh: 十月己丑，日生五色云。

translations.literal: Tenth month, day jichou, the sun had five-colored clouds.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, jichou: five-colored clouds ringed the sun.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸亥，如之。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day guihai, the same.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, guihai: the same.

sentences.zh: 三年七月己亥，夜，中天有苍白云，南北竟天，贯南北斗。

translations.literal: Year 3, seventh month, day jihai, at night at mid-heaven there were pale white clouds, north and south reaching across the sky, piercing through the Southern and Northern Dippers.
translations.idiomatic: Year 3, seventh month, jihai, at night: pale white clouds at mid-heaven stretched north and south across the sky, piercing the Southern and Northern Dippers.

sentences.zh: 八年十一月戊辰，夜，东南方有苍白云，东西亘天。

translations.literal: Year 8, eleventh month, day wuchen, at night in the southeast there were pale white clouds, east and west spanning heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Year 8, eleventh month, wuchen, at night: pale white clouds in the southeast spanned east and west across the sky.

sentences.zh: 九年十一月甲午，月生五色云。

translations.literal: Year 9, eleventh month, day jiawu, the moon had five-colored clouds.
translations.idiomatic: Year 9, eleventh month, jiawu: five-colored clouds ringed the moon.

sentences.zh: 十年九月丁酉，日生五色云。

translations.literal: Year 10, ninth month, day dingyou, the sun had five-colored clouds.
translations.idiomatic: Year 10, ninth month, dingyou: five-colored clouds ringed the sun.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲午，月生五色云。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day jiawu, the moon had five-colored clouds.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, jiawu: five-colored clouds ringed the moon.

sentences.zh: 十四年十月庚申，昼生苍白云，复化为三，东西南北竟天。

translations.literal: Year 14, tenth month, day gengshen, by day pale white clouds arose, again transformed into three, east, west, south, and north reaching across the sky.
translations.idiomatic: Year 14, tenth month, gengshen: by day pale white clouds arose, then split into three stretching east, west, south, and north across the sky.

sentences.zh: 景泰元年六月乙酉，赤云四道，两头锐如耕垅状，徐徐东北行而散。

translations.literal: Jingtai year 1, sixth month, day yiyou, four red cloud streaks, both ends sharp like plow-furrow ridges, slowly moving northeast and dispersing.
translations.idiomatic: Jingtai 1, sixth month, yiyou: four streaks of red cloud, both ends sharp like plow furrows, drifted slowly northeast and dispersed.

sentences.zh: 八月甲戌，黑云如山，化作龙虎麋鹿状。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day jiaxu, black clouds like mountains, transforming into shapes of dragons, tigers, elk, and deer.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, jiaxu: black clouds like mountains took the shapes of dragons, tigers, elk, and deer.

sentences.zh: 九月丙寅，有苍白云气，南北亘天。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day bingyin, there was pale white cloud vapor, north and south spanning heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, bingyin: pale white cloud vapor stretched north and south across the sky.

sentences.zh: 二年六月戊寅，日上五色云。

translations.literal: Year 2, sixth month, day wuyin, five-colored clouds on the sun.
translations.idiomatic: Year 2, sixth month, wuyin: five-colored clouds ringed the sun.

sentences.zh: 九月辛酉，夜苍白云三，东西竟天。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day xinyou, at night three pale white clouds, east and west reaching across the sky.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, xinyou, at night: three pale white clouds stretched east and west across the sky.

sentences.zh: 三年正月癸亥，东南有黑云，如人戴笠而揖。

translations.literal: Year 3, first month, day guihai, in the southeast there was black cloud like a person wearing a bamboo hat and bowing.
translations.idiomatic: Year 3, first month, guihai: in the southeast black cloud appeared like a person in a bamboo hat making a bow.

sentences.zh: 四年十一月丁卯，月生五色云。

translations.literal: Year 4, eleventh month, day dingmao, the moon had five-colored clouds.
translations.idiomatic: Year 4, eleventh month, dingmao: five-colored clouds ringed the moon.

sentences.zh: 天顺二年十月壬申，四年十月戊午，亦如之。

translations.literal: Tianshun year 2, tenth month, day renshen, year 4 tenth month, day wuwu, also the same.
translations.idiomatic: Tianshun 2, tenth month, renshen, and year 4, tenth month, wuwu: likewise.

sentences.zh: 成化二年三月辛未，白云起南方，东西竟天。

translations.literal: Chenghua year 2, third month, day xinwei, white clouds arose in the south, east and west reaching across the sky.
translations.idiomatic: Chenghua 2, third month, xinwei: white clouds rose in the south and stretched east and west across the sky.

sentences.zh: 十一年正月丙寅，月生五色云。

translations.literal: Year 11, first month, day bingyin, the moon had five-colored clouds.
translations.idiomatic: Year 11, first month, bingyin: five-colored clouds ringed the moon.

sentences.zh: 十八年十月庚午，五色云见于泰陵。

translations.literal: Year 18, tenth month, day gengwu, five-colored clouds appeared at Taoling.
translations.idiomatic: Year 18, tenth month, gengwu: five-colored clouds appeared at Taoling.

sentences.zh: 二十一年闰四月壬辰，开、濮二州，清丰，金乡，未、申时黑云起西北，化为五色，须臾晦如夜。

translations.literal: Year 21, intercalary fourth month, day renchen, Kai and Pu prefectures, Qingfeng and Jinxiang, at the wei and shen hours black clouds arose in the northwest, transformed into five colors, and presently it was dark as night.
translations.idiomatic: Year 21, intercalary fourth month, renchen: in Kai and Pu prefectures and in Qingfeng and Jinxiang, at the wei and shen hours (1–5 p.m.) black clouds rose in the northwest, turned five-colored, and presently the sky was dark as night.

sentences.zh: 弘治二年正月辛巳，日生五色云。

translations.literal: Hongzhi year 2, first month, day xinsi, the sun had five-colored clouds.
translations.idiomatic: Hongzhi 2, first month, xinsi: five-colored clouds ringed the sun.

sentences.zh: 十四年三月己酉朔，嘉靖十七年九月戊子，并如之。

translations.literal: Year 14, third month, day jiyou new moon, Jiajing year 17 ninth month, day wuzi, all the same.
translations.idiomatic: Hongzhi 14/III/jiyou new moon and Jiajing 17/IX/wuzi: the same.

sentences.zh: 十八年二月庚子朔，当午，日下有五色云见，长径二寸余，形如龙凤。

translations.literal: Year 18, second month, day gengzi new moon, at noon, beneath the sun five-colored clouds appeared, length and diameter more than two cun, shaped like dragon and phoenix.
translations.idiomatic: Jiajing 18, second month, new moon on gengzi, at noon: five-colored clouds appeared beneath the sun, more than two cun long and wide, shaped like dragon and phoenix.

sentences.zh: 万历五年六月庚辰，祥云绕月。

translations.literal: Wanli year 5, sixth month, day gengchen, auspicious clouds encircled the moon.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 5, sixth month, gengchen: auspicious clouds encircled the moon.

sentences.zh: 天启四年六月癸巳，午刻，南方五色云见。

translations.literal: Tianqi year 4, sixth month, day guisi, at the noon watch, in the south five-colored clouds appeared.
translations.idiomatic: Tianqi 4, sixth month, guisi, at the noon watch: five-colored clouds appeared in the south.
